product.further_description: The original Rum. Produce of Jamaica, Guyana and Barbados. The legend of Captain Morgan began over 300 years ago. His infamous career included life as a buccaneer, Admiral of the Fleet and culminated in 1680 with his appointment as Governor General of Jamaica. At that time his interests turned to his sugar cane plantation and the perfection of a rum worthy to bear his name. The rich smooth flavour of Captain Morgan rum is enjoyed by anyone who seeks the true taste of the Caribbean. The superior quality of Captain Morgan is firstly owed to the rum's provenance, as the Captain is a premium blend of five rum marques from three different Caribbean countries, allowing for greater complexity of flavour. Then the rum is distilled partly using the traditional 'pot stilled' process resulting in greater quality and fuller flavour. Finally the rum is aged for at least two years in charred oak barrels before the Ron Maestro (master blender) performs his art in the secret blending of the finished liquid. The resulting rum is one of superior quality & taste. Incredibly rich & smooth, you will taste many flavours including toffee & vanilla, with a rounded oaken nose. Enjoy Captain Morgan with cola or ginger ale, plenty of ice & a twist of lime.

product.detailed_description: A collaboration between craft distiller, Portland’s House Spirits, and acclaimed bartender Ryan Magarian - Aviation American Gin has been created specifically with cocktails in mind. A pioneer of the ‘New Western Dry’ style of gin now gaining popularity, Aviation American Gin has a unique recipe, focussing on a ‘Botanical Democracy’ rather than the standard, dictatorial influence of juniper. Therefore, Aviation American Gin is a renegade, regional style of gin- completely different from all other gins on the market. Full bodied, with a weighty mouth feel and rich flavour profile, Aviation American Gin makes the perfect base for cocktails, including the Aviation cocktail first created in the early 1900’s - the cocktail after which we named our gin. Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week

product.brand_marketing: Hailing from the oldest distillery on the Isle of Skye, Talisker 10 Year Old has been made by the sea since 1830. Ialisker’s aromas and taste instantly connect you to its rugged maritime home with every sip. In 2020 Talisker announced a 3-year partnership with Parley for the Ocean with a commitment to support and protect 100million square meters of marine ecosystems through the campaign to Rewild Our Seas The new packaging on Talisker is 99.8% recyclable with 86% less plastic components by weight.
product.detailed_description: Produced at the oldest distillery on the Isle of Skye, Talisker Single Malt Scotch Whisky has been made by the sea since 1830, with its smell and taste instantly connecting you to its rugged maritime home. Every sip is a taste of the Isle of Skye itself, one of the most remote, windswept yet beautiful landscapes in Scotland. Talisker 10 Year Old, the stalwart of the Talisker family, is a powerful single malt whisky, with a sea-salty nose, spicy complexity, smoky sweet character and signature peppery finish: like a warm welcome from a wild sea. This single malt has a famously rich and powerful peat-smoke flavour, while the finish leaves you with a warm peppery taste at the back of the mouth. With an appetizing sweetness and long finish, enjoy neat or on the rocks. It is double distilled to create a rich, deep character embodying the maritime characteristics of a coastal whisky, and then aged for a minimum of 10 years in American oak casks. It is one of the most awarded single malt scotch whiskies in the world including the double gold medal win at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition for four years in a row, with latest being 2020. Delivered in a beautiful maritime gift box, Talisker 10 Year Old makes a perfect present for adventurers who share the wild spirit of our founders, who rowed to the Isle of Skye in 1830 where Talisker has been distilled ever since. Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week

product.brand_marketing: Haig Club is built on nearly 400 years of distilling heritage and the House of Haig can trace its whisky-producing roots back to the seventeenth century. In 1824 John Haig established the Cameronbridge distillery where he pioneered the art of producing grain whisky in continuous Coffey and Stein stills - an invention which laid the foundations for the growth and success of the modern Scotch Whisky industry. Haig Club is born of that Haig family legacy of innovation and excellence in whisky making. The Haig Club unique bottle design draws on a history of innovative bottles produced by the House of Haig, including the Haig Dimple Bottle, recognisable the world over. The Haig Club brand was inspired in part by archive materials dating back to the 1920's in which Haig whisky was advertised as "The clubman's whisky". This stunning single grain has a fresh, clean style showcasing butterscotch-smooth tropical fruit and slick, spicy base notes; it's a smooth, sophisticated new take on Scotch that's perfect to sip over ice or as the heart of light long drink. Haig Club New Old Fashioned, Haig Clubhouse Soda
product.detailed_description: Haig Club Clubman Single Grain Scotch Whisky is a stylish and contemporary single grain Scotch whisky that offers a delicious drinking experience. Crafted in Scotland, it is renowned for its smooth texture and accessible flavour profile, making it a great choice for both whisky enthusiasts and newcomers alike. This whisky is carefully distilled using a combination of malted barley and corn, and then matured in a variety of casks, including first-fill American oak casks, which contribute to its distinctive character. This ageing process allows the whisky to develop a harmonious blend of flavours. Clubhouse Soda A modern twist on the classic Whisky & Soda, brought up to date with your choice of aromatic bitters to suit every Haig Club drinker. product.detailed_description: Nestled in a hidden cove near Port Askaig, Islay, the Caol Ila (pronounced “Cull Eela”) distillery sent its whisky to market by sea for over a hundred years. Caol Ila is the Gaelic name for the Sound of Islay, which separates the island from Jura in one of the most remote and beautiful parts of Scotland's West Coast. The distillery was founded in 1846 and is situated on the shores of the Sound, a spot originally chosen partly because of the clean water from Loch Nam Ban which still provides its main supply. Fresh, sweetly fruity and smooth-bodied, Caol Ila 12 year old is the colour of pale straw, with a delicate balance of tastes. The clean, appetising nose shows subtle citrus fruit with just a puff of smoke. Firm and smooth, it begins sweetly then yields a fragrant smokiness and a sweet-smoky, lingering finish. This single malt was named Outstanding Silver Medal Winner at the International Wine & Spirits Competition 2015. The ultimate Islay malt, Caol Ila is considered by experts to be the perfect entry point into the world of peaty malt whiskies and a reference for connoisseurs of Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky the world over. product.brand_marketing: Today the Red Dragon (in Welsh, Y Ddraig Goch) is the proud national flag of Wales. This fiery creature is close to our hearts. It is thought that the ancient Welsh kings were using the dragon as a royal emblem by the early 5th century AD. In this they followed Roman cohorts that carried hollow metal 'draco' standards, through which the wind howled, to instill fear in their foes. Wales is part of the United Kingdom and home to the native people of the British Isles. Welsh national identity emerged among the Celtic Britons after the Roman withdrawal in the 5th century. In this country, rich in myth and legend, the people have a quiet power and passion and many still speak the ancient Welsh language. Penderyn make award-winning whiskies and spirits at their distillery in the foothills of the Brecon Beacons National Park in South Wales. The area has spectacular mountain scenery, open moorland, farmland and valleys containing fast-flowing streams, rivers and waterfalls. The Making of Legend Our unique copper stills are charged with a fermented barley 'wash'. This is distilled to produce a flavourful spirit of extraordinary strength and purity which is married with water from the Brecon Beacons before maturing in the finest ex-bourbon casks. Penderyn Legend is matured in specially reserved ex-bourbon casks made from American Oak, before receiving a further maturation in oak barriques that have previously held Madeira wine, to develop a harmonious single malt whisky with a subtle but sophisticated character and soft golden hues. This great all-rounder is the essential expression of the legendary Penderyn house style and has all the richness of flavour and light fruitiness that Penderyn is famous for world-wide.
product.detailed_description: Tasting Notes Aromas of fresh apples and citrus fruits intermingle with cream fudge and sultana raisins in the nose to create a complex yet fresh, clean and well-balanced whisky. In the mouth this single malt whisky is incredibly smooth and both fresh and rich dried fruits abound. Delicate and sweet on the palate with just a hint of bitterness to remain refreshing then slowly this Penderyn presents a long finish leaving an aftertaste of Madeira cake and sultanas. product.detailed_description: Brush-Baby Teething Toothpaste for Babies & Toddlers 0-2 years Applemint flavour, with soothing Camomile. Xylitol & Fluoride for strong teeth, healthy gums & fresh breath 50ml BABIES AND TODDLERS LOVE THE TASTE OF THIS TOOTHPASTE! An ideal first toothpaste or an alternative for little ones who are picky or don’t like minty flavours. Specially formulated for the teething stage, with a gentle applemint flavour that tiny tastebuds will love, plus camomile to soothe sore gums. The gentle fruity flavour and soothing formulation are the ideal way to encourage your little one if they are reluctant to brush! CREATE LOVELY SWEET-SMELLING KISSES! Suitable from birth, this toothpaste is rich in Xylitol - a natural ingredient which reduces sugar acids that can cause tooth decay, morning breath and dummy breath. The enamel of baby teeth tends to be thinner and needs extra protection. Brush-Baby Teething Toothpaste is lower in fluoride (500 ppmF) to help strengthen baby tooth enamel whilst being safer for your little one if swallowed. Just use a smear on a Brush-Baby manual, electric or Chewable toothbrush at brushing time. CONTAINS CAMOMILE FOR NATURAL RELIEF FROM TEETHING. Camomile is a natural anti-inflammatory which can help to soothe sore gums. Brush-Baby Teething toothpaste is also SLS-free and non-foaming, Paraben-free, Dairy-free, Cruelty-free, Glitter-free, Microbead-free, and suitable for Vegans and Vegetarians. The tube has a safety seal and an easy to open and close flip-top cap. Product packaging material is recyclable. GIVE YOUR CHILDREN’S TEETH THE BEST START. Suitable from 0 - 24 months. Oral care starts on day one and you should clean your newborn baby's mouth, gums and tongue every day. Keeping teething gums clean can help to avoid gum inflammation and pain during teething. When baby teeth start to come through, it’s important to brush from the first tooth. Cleaning your little one’s teeth twice a day with a toothbrush and a small amount of age-appropriate toothpaste helps remove bacteria, keep their mouth healthy and starts to get them used to the brushing routine. KEEPING YOUR LITTLE ONE'S SMILES HAPPY AND HEALTHY. Brush-Baby was inspired by a little girl who chewed her toothbrush! We know what it takes to give your babies, toddlers, young children and older kids the best start with their oral health and encourage them to develop healthy brushing habits.

product.brand_marketing: Bruichladdich's flagship single malt range explores the infinite possibilities of what whisky can and should be. In a mission to uncover flavour at every opportunity, these Islay single malts have become a liquid embodiment of the distillery's unrelenting curiosity. The depth of the range is complex, yet rewarding, as variety and nuance is celebrated in every fruitful drop. Unlike Bruichladdich's neighbouring distilleries on the island of Islay, the Bruichladdich range is made without peat. Without the influence of smoke, the brilliance of the primary raw ingredient, barley, is exposed. Stepping further outside of whisky tradition, ingredients are traced from origin to bottling - embracing every growing season, the subtlety of changing barley varietals and the methods applied in growing them. With the same vigour, the distilling process is patient and purposeful; with a slow fermentation in wooden washbacks and trickle distillation through tall, narrow necked stills, this 100% Scottish barley distilled spirit is filled into an ever-evolving suite of top-quality casks. In a final commitment to quality and community, this whisky is bottled unchill-filtered and colouring free, inside the distillery gates, using Islay spring water. product.preparation_and_usage: Please retain instructions for future use. Cleaning and sterilising Before first use, clean the teat and place it in boiling water for 5 minutes. product.brand_marketing: Casamigos is a small batch, ultra-premium 100% Blue Weber agave tequila founded by George Clooney and long-time friends, Rande Gerber and Michael Meldman. Casamigos is named after Clooney and Gerber's homes in Mexico, and roughly translates to “House of Friends”. It was originally created out of their desire to enjoy the best-tasting, smoothest tequila that didn't have to be covered up with salt or lime. So they did. They worked on the creation of Casamigos with their master distiller in Jalisco, Mexico for years, and held many blind tastings until they knew they had got it right. Casamigos was always intended for personal use, to be shared with family and friends. Casamigos Blanco has won a multitude of international awards including Gold at the 2015 Los Angeles International Spirits Competition and Double Gold Medal Winner at the 2014 San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

product.brand_marketing: THE AWKWARD TRUTH For too long Islay has been exploited by those seeking to trade on the cachet of its name. It's become a badge to add credibility and value, with increasingly fragile links to the reality of the island. Islay has become a flavour profile not a provenance, with distillers importing barley from outside Scotland, then shipping spirit off the island to mature in undisclosed mainland warehouses. What does it really mean to be an Islay single malt? For the makers of Port Charlotte single malt, it means commitment to Islay, investment in place and people, it means that everything must happen on the island and in the community. The whisky must be a true expression of the land, the culture, the people. OUR ISLAY REVOLUTION The makers of Port Charlotte are rooted in the culture and community of Islay. Of nine distilleries on the island, they are the third smallest producer but the largest private employer. Over 80 of the company's employees are based on the island. This means something. From the outset it has been their ambition to create the highest provenance Islay whisky. There are easier places to make whisky. There are easier methods and processes and its cheaper to build warehouses on the mainland. But they are not interested in easy options. Port Charlotte single malt is conceived, distilled, matured and bottled only on Islay. AN ALTERNATIVE ‘ISLAY' Port Charlotte single malts are peated to a heavyweight 40PPM. Trickle distilled through tall, narrow necked still, the resulting rich and aromatic spirit has all the power of peat with the elegance and finesse for which the stills are famous. Port Charlotte spirits are matured all their life in the distillery's warehouses on the side of Loch Indaal, meaning they gradually respond to the sea air and unique seasonal changes of Scotland's west coast. Each cask is carefully watched over by the team, before being bottled in the Harvey Hall, using Islay spring water. Port Charlotte single malt explores the complexities of natural whisky, through barley provenance, cask influence and the passing of time. It is living proof that the distillery's values are rooted in provenance, authenticity and transparency.

product.further_description: Port Charlotte 10 is a heavily peated Islay single malt Scotch whisky conceived, distilled, matured and bottled only on Islay. Made from 100% Scottish barley, it reflects Bruichladdich's ambition to create the ultimate Islay whisky — one shaped by the island, its community and its maritime environment from start to finish. Trickle distilled through tall, narrow-necked stills, it develops a balanced, heathery style of barbecue smoke rather than an overpowering peat profile. The flavour is rich yet composed, combining smoke with notes of coconut, vanilla custard and lemon honey for a whisky that feels both powerful and precise. Bottled at 50% ABV, non chill-filtered, matured entirely on Islay, bottled using Islay spring water and colouring free, it offers texture, depth and a true sense of place. Bold, characterful and unmistakably Islay, this is a whisky for drinkers who appreciate provenance, peated complexity and the balance of smoke, sweetness and coastal freshness.

product.brand_marketing: We always like to say that everything you need to know about Jameson is right here - either on our bottle or in our bottle - encapsulating our full story. The label features our family crest and motto. Proclaiming ‘Sine Metu', it means ‘Without Fear'. It's the reason John Jameson first triple distilled Irish whiskey, creating Jameson Irish Whiskey as we know it. So in the spirit of Sine Metu, let us take you on a journey. Pull up a chair…
product.detailed_description: Jameson Irish whiskey is a triple-distilled blended Irish whiskey, as versatile as it is smooth. Whiskey like Jameson isn't just born smooth and balanced. First, we take the best of pot still and fine grain whiskeys. Then we triple distil them. Not because we have to, because we want to. This gives Jameson its signature smoothness. This tradition began in 1780 with John Jameson, and we continue his legacy to this day. Finally, we age our whiskey in oak casks for a minimum of 4 years. The result? A unique whiskey with a perfect balance of spicy, nutty and vanilla notes with hints of sweet sherry. Simply enjoy neat, poured over ice, or in any of your favourite whiskey cocktails. Winner of the 2018 The Irish Whiskey Masters (TIWM) Gold award Tasting Notes Colour: Rich, deep amber. Nose: Jameson has a light floral fragrance, peppered with spicy wood and sweet notes. Taste: Perfect balance of spicy, nutty and vanilla notes with hints of sweet sherry. Finish: Exceptional smoothness. Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week

Despite its smokiness, Ardbeg is renowned for its delicious sweetness, a phenomenon that has affectionately become. known as ‘the peaty paradox’. product.brand_marketing: Balvenie is one of the world's most loved Single Malt Scotch Whiskies. The multi-award winning Balvenie Distillery in Banffshire is famous for being the only one left in Scotland to retain the traditional crafts of whisky production. Nowhere else will you find a distillery that still grows its own barley, still malts in its own traditional floor maltings and still employs a team of coopers to tend all the casks and a coppersmith to maintain the stills. Meanwhile our maltmen turn the barley up to four times a day, seven days a week. The Distillery has been owned and managed by the same independent family company for five generations.
product.detailed_description: To make The Balvenie 14 Year Old Caribbean Cask, David Stewart MBE takes whisky that has spent at least 14 years in American oak ex-bourbon barrels oak casks, before transferring it to casks that once contained Caribbean rum. This allows the first casks to slowly impart the familiar flavours of The Balvenie - that characterful taste of vanilla and smooth rich honey. The result is an exceptional single malt whisky, acquiring the traditional smooth, honeyed character of The Balvenie, married with notes of toffee, a hint of fruit, with a warm, lingering finish. Balvenie is one of the world's most loved Single Malt Scotch Whiskies. The multi-award winning Balvenie Distillery in Banffshire is famous for being the only one left in Scotland to retain the traditional crafts of whisky production. Nowhere else will you find a distillery that still grows its own barley, still malts in its own traditional floor maltings and still employs a team of coopers to tend all the casks and a coppersmith to maintain the stills. Meanwhile our maltmen turn the barley up to four times a day, seven days a week. The Distillery has been owned and managed by the same independent family company for five generations. product.brand_marketing: Maker's Mark is known the world over for its handmade premium bourbon. Created by sixth generation distiller Bill Samuels, Sr. in 1953, the smooth and approachable nature changed the bourbon industry. Still family run -- now by Bill's grandson Rob Samuels -- Makers Mark continues to innovate, creating bourbons that are as easy-drinking as they are revolutionary. To this day, every drop is made slowly in small batches, in the National Historic Landmark distillery in Loretto, Kentucky.
product.detailed_description: Maker's 46 redefines bourbon with a unique experience crafted by Bill Samuels, Jr., the legacy of Maker's Mark founders. Introduced in 2010, it stands as the first major expression since classic Maker's in 1953. This exceptional bourbon undergoes a distinctive finishing process, aging longer with seared French oak staves. Ten of these staves are placed into cask strength Maker's Mark barrels, allowing the whisky to mature in optimal conditions. The result is a bourbon with layered notes, balanced complexity, and a longer finish, featuring caramel, vanilla, and baking spice. Maker's 46 is a testament to Bill Samuels, Jr.'s taste vision, pushing bourbon craftsmanship boundaries. The wood-finishing series, initiated by Maker's 46, led to expressions like Maker's Mark Private Selection. With a commitment to experimentation and honoring the founders' legacy, Maker's 46 invites enthusiasts to savor a bourbon that reimagines tradition while reflecting the enduring dedication of Bill and Margie to exceptional spirits. product.detailed_description: In 1870, Old Forester became America’s First Bottled Bourbon when founder George Garvin Brown revolutionized the industry by being the first to put Bourbon in a glass bottle. Five generations and nearly 150 years later, Old Forester delivers a genuine Bourbon experience with 86 and 100 Proof at the core of the family. At 86 Proof, Old Forester delivers a fresh and bright flavor profile perfect for sipping neat, on the rocks, with a splash of water or in a classic cocktail. Aroma: Strong, sweet coffee laced with chocolate, creamy butterscotch and a hint of liquorice Color: Bright, dense caramel toffee Taste: Sharp and sweet, with a strong floral character that swirls with hints of mint, rich tobacco leaf and vanilla. A touch of oak and pine provides a strong underpinning, 2019 SAN FRANCISCO WORLDS SPIRITS COMPETITION - GOLD MEDAL., 2018 AMERICAN WHISKY MASTERS Silver Medal, Bourbon Premium, 2016 ULTIMATE SPIRITS CHALLENGE® - 95, Extraordinary, Ultimate Recommendation.
product.further_description: Double distilled using a proprietary yeast strain, aged in hand-crafted, toasted and charred new American white oak barrels 72% Corn 18% Rye 10% Malt Brand History: OLD FORESTER IS "AMERICA'S FIRST BOTTLED BOURBON", AND THE ONLY BOURBON CONTINUOUSLY SOLD BY THE SAME COMPANY BEFORE, DURING AND AFTER PROHIBITION. In 1870, George Garvin Brown created Old Forester on Louisville’s famous Whiskey Row at 322 W. Main St. Old Forester was "America’s First Bottled Bourbon" – the first bourbon to be sold in sealed glass bottles instead of from barrels, to ensure consistent quality. It took until the U.S. Bottled in Bond Act of 1897 for U.S. government regulations to catch up, when sealed bottles became a requirement. One of America’s founding bourbons, Old Forester continued to thrive until 1920, when Prohibition began. Many distilleries were closed, but fortunately, Brown-Forman applied for and received a license from the U.S. government to continue producing Old Forester for medicinal purposes. When Prohibition was repealed in 1933, Old Forester became the only remaining bourbon continuously sold by the same company before, during and after Prohibition. Today, the Old Forester brand and its many expressions are prized by bartenders and consumers alike for their authentic bourbon taste.

But understanding the language of liquor is more than just having a sharp palate. Jackie leverages a background in Biology, Chemistry, and of course, mixology from her years spent behind the bar - a rare combination that gives a unique perspective into the brand and the makings of a delicious whisky. Ensuring that there’s truly “nothing better in the market,” Jackie oversees proofing, maturation and quality across all expressions of Old Forester, including the highly coveted annual release of Birthday Bourbon.But as any former bartender knows, a good drink is also about presentation. Which is why Jackie conducts master level trainings across the globe, leads Old Forester’s single barrel private selection program and innovative licensed expansions of the brand, and oversees the brand drink strategy across all platforms._x000b_And like a good drink, Jackie also has a tremendous follow-through, which is why throughout the years, she has also been published globally for industry insights, cocktail strategies and brand education. She serves as the face of the brand, traveling the world to share the story of Old Forester’s production and history as the First Bottled Bourbon™.

product.preparation_and_usage: Step 1: Prepare Protect your clothing with an old towel. Wearing the gloves provided in your kit, pour the contents of bottle 1 into bottle 2. Shake thoroughly until fully blended. Step 2: Apply Starting at the roots, apply colour mixture immediately all over dry, unwashed hair. Work the colour through your hair to ensure full saturation. Leave colour on for 20 minutes. Step 3: Finish When time has elapsed, rinse until water runs clear. Follow with the deep conditioner in bottle 3. Leave on for 2 minutes. Rinse. Use remaining Colour Treat Conditioner once a week after shampooing. Tips and Tricks: As it is a semi-permanent hair dye, this means that your hair can go darker, stay at your same level of lightness and/or add tones & hues, but you cannot lighten your natural colour. It's perfect for washing up and wiping down all around the house! Efficient with just water, no dirt or marks will stand in its way. Use the grey scrubbing side to remove stubborn marks and stains without scratching and the blue microfibre side to remove dirt and grease with ease. Top tip: dedicate a Scrub & Wipe to each task and after using them pop them in the washing machine to re-use again and again. Composition: Blue side: 85% Polyester, 15% Polyamide. product.detailed_description: Highly concentrated moisturising cream for dry skin. This rich, protective cream replenishes the skin and helps repair dry areas. It contains Squalane, a natural component found in the skin’s oil. Areas prone to dryness like the elbows, knees and hands will just love what QV Cream can do to help. Suitable for dry or sensitive skin. Replenishes dry skin. It is free from perfume, lanolin and propylene glycol, pH balanced with dermatological formula. Suitable for use with eczema, dermatitis and psoriasis. QV Cream is also suitable for infants and the elderly. For persistent dry skin use with QV Bath Oil and QV Wash. Avoid soap as it may irritate sensitive skin. Benefits - Proven to moisturise dry skin for 24 hours. - Protects against water loss by sealing in the skin’s own natural moisture by acting as a protective barrier. - Helps protect against dryness. - pH balanced, low-irritant formulation, free from fragrance, colour, Lanolin and Propylene Glycol. - Suitable for skin conditions such as dry, scaly skin, eczema, psoriasis and dermatitis. - Suitable for sensitive skin. - Suitable for infants and the elderly. - Vegan Friendly - contains no animal derived ingredients. Ingredients highlight: - Dimethicone: A silicone that helps to protect the skin by forming a water-repellent barrier against water soluble irritants. - Glycerin: A humectant, helping to draw and hold water to the skin to maintain hydration. - Paraffinum Liquidum: Also known as Liquid Paraffin, an emollient that helps to reduce moisture loss from the outermost layer of the skin to maintain hydration. - Petrolatum: A highly effective emollient, used to promote both short- and long-term skin rehydration. - Squalane: Naturally-occurring component of the skins oil (sebum), this emollient works as a vehicle to help carry other substances or ingredients across the skin.
product.ingredients: Aqua (Water), Paraffinum Liquidum, Glycerin, Petrolatum, Cetearyl Alcohol, Dimethicone, Squalane, Ceteareth-20, Glyceryl Stearate SE, Stearic Acid, Laureth-3, Glyceryl Stearate, Methylparaben (E218), Dichlorobenzyl Alcohol.

product.preparation_and_usage: Directions Apply moisturising cream to affected areas as often as required, particularly after washing, bathing, showering, shaving, exposure to harsh climatic conditions and at night. Cautions Consumers using large quantities of any paraffin based product, such as QV Cream, should regularly change clothing or bedding impregnated with the product and keep away from naked flames as there is a fire risk. For external use only. Do not apply to wounds. Avoid eyes. Do not use if sensitive to any ingredients. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Avoid soap on affected areas to prevent irritation. Keep out of reach of children. Store below 30°C.

product.detailed_description: Birchall Virunga Earl Grey is a fragrant single origin tea, sourced from the finest tea gardens in Rwanda, found close to the country's border with the Democratic Republic of Congo and the Virunga National Park. In this region, the tea bushes grow slowly in rich volcanic soil, at high altitude and relatively low temperatures, developing greater flavour before they are individually picked. Our plucked tea leaves are then blended with a traditional bergamot oil to create this famously fragrant afternoon tea classic. Our plant-based Prism™ Tea bags release the full flavour of our loose leaf tea and allow for the purest infusion. They're made from biodegradable plant starch and are commercially compostable so please dispose of them in your food waste bin. The bag you can see inside is made from renewable cellulose which means it's home and commercially compostable.

product.detailed_description: Looking for a radiant, customisable glow you can control? Dove Summer Revived Medium to Dark Gradual Tan Mousse is designed to help you achieve a natural-looking, sun-kissed tan without the UV exposure. Made with Pro-Ceramides, Niacinamide, Glycerin and Sweet Almond Oil, this self tanning mousse provides regenerative moisture to replenish your skin and keep it visibly moisturised for 48 hours. As you continue to use it, the tan develops gradually, giving you full control over your desired shade. This self tanning mousse from the UK's #1 gradual self tan brand* is clinically proven, dermatologically tested and suitable for daily use on all skin types. Plus, it's infused with a fresh fragrance of sun-ripened fruits to transform your tanning routine into a sensory experience. For a customisable, sunless glow that looks naturally radiant, shake the can well and massage a small amount of mousse evenly onto clean, dry skin. A little goes a long way! Wash hands after use. Allow to fully absorb before dressing. Always apply a separate sunscreen product if spending time in the sun. Do not spray near eyes. product.detailed_description: Plaque busting and low in calories, our plant based dental sticks are just what your four legged friend needs to keep their teeth pristine and mouths busy! Our sticks are air-dried for an extra long chew time, they're also hypoallergenic so perfect for sensitive tummies. No more furniture chewing! What's in our apple and eucalyptus sticks? - Eucalyptus for freshness: dogs aren't famous for their fresh breath. We use the natural power if eucalyptus to keep bad smells at bay. - Calcium for strength: strong teeth are healthy teeth, so we add calcium to our sticks to keep your dogs pearly whites full of fight. - Apple and coconut for flavour: we chose plant-based flavours we know dogs love, so they keep chewing their way to a clean & healthy mouth.

product.recipes: Traditional Sourdough Loaf 650g Loaf Delicious served with butter. 425g Very Strong Canadian Bread Flour 275g Water 150g Sourdough starter 8g Salt Oven 250°C / Fan 230°C / Gas mark 9 then 220°C / Fan 200°C / Gas mark 7 1. Mix all the ingredients together. 2. Knead by hand for 15 minutes or in a stand mixer for 10 minutes. 3. Shape into a ball, put into a bowl and cover. 4. Leave to prove for approx 6 hours or until it has doubled in size. 5. Flour a proving basket or line a bowl with a tea towel and flour it. 6. Carefully re-shape the dough into a ball so you do not knock out all the air. Put into the basket/bowl & cover. 7. Leave for 1 hour in a warm place and then put in the fridge overnight. 8. The next day, put 2 trays into the oven on different shelves, heat the oven to 250°C/Fan 230°C/Gas Mark 9. 9. Remove dough from fridge, dust top with flour and turn out carefully onto a heated tray. 10. Very carefully, with a sharp knife, cut a 1cm slash across the top of the loaf. 11. Pour in some water to the bottom tray in the oven to create steam. Pop the bread onto the higher shelf. 12. Turn the oven down to 220°C/Fan 200°C/Gas mark 7. Bake for 30-40 minutes or until the loaf sounds hollow when tapped at the base.

While Tanqueray shines in a classic Gin & Tonic with tonic water, ice, and a lime wedge, its potential extends far beyond. This best-selling gin, was awarded ‘Highly Commended’ in The Gin Guide Awards, and is perfect whether in a G&T, or in your favourite gin cocktail. Explore endless recipe possibilities and discover your new favourite drink using Tanqueray London Dry Gin. For best performance: Pour water into vase and place the hyacinth bulb on top, pointed side up. The roots of the bulb need to be in water, but the bulb itself should not be wet. Place the vase in a cool, dark and airy place (less than 10°C - such as a shed or garage) for about 8-12 weeks or until the shoot is 4cm. It is very important for the bulb to be in this cold condition for root & flower development. Check water weekly. Do not allow to dry out at any time. At this stage move indoors to a light position at normal room temperature. Flowering should begin within 10-14 days. Turn occasionally as the flower will grow towards the light.

product.brand_marketing: George Smith, The Glenlivet's founder, didn't follow the lead of the illegal still owners. In 1824, he obtained a distiller's licence to become the first legal distiller in Glenlivet, Scotland. 50 years later, George finally won the exclusive right to call his whisky ‘THE Glenlivet', definitively marking it as the single malt that started it all. To this day, The Glenlivet remains the benchmark that all other Speyside single malts are measured against.
product.detailed_description: The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve is a new rum barrel finished single malt Scotch, which combines the heritage of Scotch whisky with the flavour and soul of the Caribbean. Our founder, George Smith, instilled a culture of creativity within our brand DNA and with The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve, we have once again challenged the status quo. At The Glenlivet we are always looking at new ways to explore different flavours to break old whisky conventions. After experimenting with Cognac casks in the past, it seemed only natural that we would set our sights on other cask experiments and rum barrels were next. By bringing rum barrels and Scotch together for the first time in our history, we have brought some bold and tropical Caribbean flavours to our traditional Speyside style. Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week

product.detailed_description: A simple yet stylish set of mills made from acrylic. The smooth clear acrylic body is multiply faceted offering a striking finish that refracts the contents for a unique and modern take on a traditional pepper mill. Instantly adds style to any dining table whilst remaining an invaluable every day kitchen tool. Usage The mills come partially filled with premium quality coarse sea salt from Belgium and pepper from Vietnam so are ready to use from the moment you receive them. The hardwearing qualities of the mechanism ensure you will always receive a consistently outstanding performance. Easily refill your mill by simply unscrewing the knob on top and remove along with the top. Fill up with your favourite salt and pepper, replace the tops and continue enjoying expertly seasoned food. Adjust the grind by tightening or loosening the knob on top. Use a coarse setting for steaks or tomato salad, a medium setting for pizzas and a fine setting for soups and sauces. Featuring Cole & Mason sharp ceramic mechanisms for an accurate grind, ensuring maximum flavour release from every turn. Designed and engineered in England, the hardwearing qualities of the mechanism ensure you will always receive a consistently outstanding performance. Hints & tips If your mill becomes difficult to grind, particularly on a fine setting, trying clearing the mechanism. Turn the mill upside down, loosen the knob to the coarsest setting and twist the top. This will free any large salt crystals that may have become lodged. Retighten the knob to the desired setting. We understand how new and exciting ingredients along with high quality kitchen tools and accessories can transform cooking and dining experiences. We have been designing and developing kitchenware from our head office in England since 1919. Awarded CoolBrands status for 2014/2015, we offer a well-established and intuitively designed range, with a product for every seasoning task from the kitchen to the table. Whether you need a manual or electronic mill, simple shakers, dry or fresh herb & spice products, pestle & mortar or an oil & vinegar pourer, all our products are manufactured with the highest quality materials and available in a wide range of finishes.

product.brand_marketing: Welcome to Bowmore. Prepare to savour a perfected Islay single malt. Crafted since 1779, our acclaimed Scotch whisky is renowned for a remarkably expressive signature style that ages into an ever-deeper, richer, and generously rewarding character. Crafted with intent, Bowmore has an inherent appreciation as to how each moment comes to bear on the character of the whisky. We make our whiskies this way on purpose, shaping every drop, adding depth and distinction of flavour to shape our multidimensional single malt. Though we proudly hold the distinction of being Islay's first distillery, our true measure is found in every bottle we craft today. We have woven our tale into the rich tapestry of this remarkable island, yet it is the ever-enchanting art of whisky making, and the lasting memories it creates, that continue to be our inspiration. Founded in the storied year of 1779, Bowmore stands as the first licensed distillery on the enchanting island of Islay, Scotland. Here, centuries-old craftsmanship is lovingly intertwined with the island's singular maritime climate, giving rise to our legendary single malts. Our time-honored traditions, such as the meticulous art of floor malting and the patient aging in handpicked oak casks, creates whiskies that are a delicate dance of smoky, spicy notes with whispers of subtle sweetness. Though we proudly bear the title of Islay's first distiller, our true measure is found in the quality of every bottle we create. We have woven our legacy into the very fabric of this remarkable island, yet it is the ever-enchanting craft of whisky making, and the unforgettable moments it inspires, that drives us forward. product.detailed_description: A marriage of Bowmore from hand-selected American oak ex-bourbon casks and European oak oloroso sherry casks. The original Islay single malt, crafted with intent since 1779 to create an exceptionally expressive whisky. Bowmore 18 year old is a beautifully aged Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky in full bloom, where creamy texture, baked butterscotch notes, and singed cocoa step forward against layers of our signature smoke and minerality. Its character comes from a marriage of whiskies aged for 18 years in American oak ex-bourbon barrels and European oak oloroso sherry butts and puncheons. Our signature Bowmore distillery style shines brightly, bold and unexpectedly powerful, yet with a sweet clarity. Care is taken to add distinct layers of flavour at every stage: every action is judged and considered, from the hand-turned malt, dried in peat-fired kilns, to our longer fermentation times and hand-selected casks. Colour Mellow Mahogany. Aroma Creamy caramel, toffee, ripe nectarines, butterscotch, menthol and fragrant peat smoke. Palate Floral, scented confectionery, giving way to fennel seeds, liquorice, dark chocolate, brittle honeycomb, maple syrup and juicy oranges. Finish Warm and complex, with a light smokiness like a fire rekindled on a bright morning. Bowmore 18 Year Old single malt scotch whisky is exquisitely layered. The result of its maturation in hand-selected American oak ex-bourbon and European Oloroso sherry casks. Rare and remarkable. product.brand_marketing: Toki means "time" in Japanese, and is a fitting name for a whisky that shows deep respect for both tradition and reinvention. Suntory Toki marries old and new to create a groundbreaking—yet timeless—blend of whiskies from Suntory's Hakushu, Yamazaki and Chita distilleries. It combines exquisite balance with the heartfelt feelings of harmony and oneness. Rooted in authentic craftsmanship and inspired by playful spirit, each bottle of Toki is designed to instill a sense of wonder.
product.detailed_description: Toki means 'time', and this silky-smooth whisky lets you savor the moment where old meets new Japan. Heritage techniques are met with an innovative modern touch to create a subtly sweet Japanese whisky with a spicy finish. It's as vivid as it is innovative. It has fresh and herbaceous aromas of crisp green apple and basil, with each sip bringing notes of peppermint and thyme, grapefruit and green grapes. It's a wonderful way to make the classic highball cocktail by filling a glass to the brim with ice and gently pouring over Toki whisky. Top up with three measures of chilled sparkling water, poured gently along the side of the glass to avoid melting the ice or bursting the bubbles. Alternatively, sip it neat or over ice in your favorite crystal rocks glass. The Japanese respect for tradition and innovation can be seen in the unique way this whisky is made. It's a blend of a trio of whiskies from three renowned distilleries: Hakushu, Chita and Yamazaki. Mastered by Japanese craftsmanship, Toki is an innovative blend of Suntory Whisky. Pinpointing the moment where old and new Japan meet, this whisky will transport you through time. Each drop is presented in a sleek, modern bottle which makes a striking addition to any liquor cabinet. The product image displayed reflects our new packaging. product.brand_marketing: Knob Creek was created in 1992 by Booker Noe as a part of the Small Batch Bourbon Collection. It was inspired by the Bottled-In-Bond Act to represent the high quality and full flavour of pre-Prohibition-style whiskey. Knob Creek whiskey is seasoned by time and crafted with effort to deliver grounded, full American bourbon character through traditional, tried-and-true bourbon-making processes. Characterized by the sweetness of its mashbill, Knob Creek is aged a minimum of 9 years, distilled at a lower proof, and bottled at 100 proof to give it its authentic, full-flavour profile.
product.detailed_description: Raise a glass to the golden age of bourbon with Knob Creek 9 year old whiskey. Each carefully crafted drop has an unmistakable richness, signature sweetness and deep woodiness. Layers of vanilla and caramel come together to create moments worth savouring. Take a moment and drink it neat, or pay homage to the speakeasy by mixing it into a cocktail. For a twist on a favourite signature cocktail, stir up a New Fashioned - with amaretto, simple syrup and bitters. Characterized by the sweetness of its mashbill, Knob Creek Bourbon is aged for a minimum of 9 years, distilled at a lower proof, and bottled at 100 proof to give it its authentic, full-flavour profile. Each drop is poured into white oak barrels with maximum char, adding distinctive woody and sweet notes. While the spirit rests for nearly a decade, our distillers continue to hone their craft. They're committed to finding the fullest flavour, honouring the rigorous standards that defined the pre-prohibition era of bourbon. Knob Creek was created in 1992 by Booker Noe as a part of the small batch bourbon collection. It was inspired by the Bottled-in-Bond Act to represent the high quality and full flavour of pre-Prohibition-style whiskey. With its copper colour and unflinching flavour, Knob Creek 9 year old bourbon is a modern interpretation of pre-Prohibition era Bourbon. Take in the aromas of toasted nuts and oak, and savour each full-bodied sip. Rich and sweet, it's almost fruity. The long, rich and glowing finish brings a satisfying end to every mouthful. product.detailed_description: Ocado Pitted Green & Black Olives. A mix of pitted green and black olives in vegetable oil. A classic Mediterranean staple, this convenient mix of pitted green and black olives offers a perfect blend of flavours and textures. The vibrant green olives are firm, salty, and slightly tangy, while the dark, glossy black olives are typically softer, milder, and have a richer, more complex flavour. Together, they create a perfect balance of tastes that is great for a wide range of dishes. Because they are already pitted, these olives are a perfect choice for a wide range of uses. They are an essential part of any mezze platter, served alongside cheese and crackers. Their firm texture also makes them a great addition to salads for a savoury kick, or as a simple snack on their own. Pitted green and black olives are also a fantastic ingredient for cooking. They can be added to pasta sauces, stews, and casseroles for a burst of flavour. They also work wonderfully in focaccia and breads, where their salty flavour can really shine, or as a classic topping for a pizza. From cold cuts to creamy dips, spicy meats and tangy olives, we’ve got everything you need for your antipasti platter, simply search for ‘Ocado deli’.

product.brand_marketing: The First Whisky Distillery in North Wales, in Over 100 Years. The village of Abergwyngregyn is home to our distillery, and sits at the foot of the majestic Rhaeadr Fawr waterfall. Previously a slate works in the 19th century, a margarine factory during the world wars, and more recently a drinks wholesaler depot, our main distillery building was lovingly restored in 2017 and began producing whisky in 2018.
product.detailed_description: Crafted in the heart of North Wales, Aber Falls Single Malt Welsh Whisky captures the spirit of North Wales. Finished in hand-selected sherry casks, it delivers a rich, complex character with notes of dried fruit, warm spice, and a smooth, lingering finish. Colour: Deep amber On the Nose: Sweet fruits of the forest, dark berries, slight nutty notes with hints of dark chocolate. Palate: Sweet and rich, sweet sherry notes of dried fruits and subtle spice, creamy sweet malt, nuts and dark chocolate Finish: Long and lingering sweet finish

product.detailed_description: The Angel Christmas Pudding A Traditional Christmas Pudding worthy of its name. Light, moist, full of juicy fruit, crunchy nuts and finished with a good splash of alcohol, this celebration pudding is heavenly! Serves 3-4. Suitable for Vegans The Carved Angel began life in Dartmouth Devon as a restaurant in a glass fronted, three storey Tudor building where the open kitchen brought to the table the most exquisite and memorable food produced from fresh local ingredients.The highly talented Chef /Patron Joyce Molyneux named the restaurant after a wooden carving of an angel that was presented to her as a gift by a local carpenter before first opening. The statue sat proudly in the centre of the dining room until its doors closed in 2005. During the winter months, whilst the town was quiet, Joyce took advantage of the time of year to steam her Christmas Puddings made to a recipe created by the Victorian Chef Eliza Acton. Soon the success of these deliciously moist puddings spread far and wide and became the inspiration for a greater selection of gorgeous puddings and wonderful condiments created and mixed with the same high level of expertise and care using the best ingredients to ensure every mouthful is an absolute joy!

Yearly, more than 30 million acres of natural forests are destroyed by illegal logging and land clearance for development or agriculture. When you buy If You Care FSC Certified Parchment Roasting Bags, you know that the paper comes from forests that comply with the most rigorous environmental and social standards. That is why FSC is endorsed by many highly regarded non-profit environmental organizations. If You Care FSC Certified Parchment Roasting Bags are made from unbleached, totally chlorine-free TCF) paper. Most roasting bags are made from plastic which can be toxic, and likely end up in landfill. If You Care FSC Certified Parchment Roasting Bags will not stick to your food. The bags allow you to cook perfect, juicy and delicious meats and vegetables easily with little mess or clean-up. product.preparation_and_usage: Recipe: One-Bag Roasted Chicken Thighs 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 3 tbsp dry white wine 1 lemon, zested and juiced 3 cloves garlic, thinly sliced 1 tsp fresh thyme 1 lb fingerling potatoes, halved 1 leek, trimmed, sliced in 1/2" pieces 2 shallots, thinly sliced 1 lemon, thinly sliced 8 chicken thighs, skin on 1 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp sea salt 1/4 tsp cracked black pepper 3 tbsp butter Preheat oven to 400°F. In a small bowl, mix together Dijon mustard, white wine, lemon juice and zest, garlic, and thyme, then set aside. Place potatoes, leeks, and shallots in an If You Care Medium Roasting Bag seam side up on a rimmed baking sheet or roasting pan. Then season the chicken with the garlic powder, salt and pepper and place inside the bag on top of the vegetables. Place the lemon slices in the bag and pour mustard mixture on top of the chicken and vegetables and fold the open end of the bag tightly towards the top as many times as possible to seal. Roast in the oven for 35 minutes, then remove from the oven and open the bag by either ripping or cutting with scissors to expose the top of the chicken. Use extreme caution, as the steam will be very hot. Baste chicken with butter, then place back in the oven to roast for another 15-20 minutes, or until desired brownness. Serve and enjoy! How to Roast the Perfect Chicken, Fish or Vegetables If You Care Roasting Bags were developed to help you roast the perfect chicken, fish or vegetable every time. Place bag on baking pan seam side up and position prepped foods into center of bag Fold open end of bag tightly toward the top to seal bag and place baking pan in oven. When ready, remove from oven, let cool, then open top of bag along seam. Beware of hot steam. Directions: 1. Open bag fully with the seam side up and place on a large baking pan. 2. Place prepared chicken, fish or vegetables in the center of the bag with the seam side facing up. 3. Seal the open end by folding tightly as many times as possible towards the top until it snugly fits contents. 4. Roast food at correct time and temperature for its weight and then remove the baking pan with roasting bag from the oven. 5. Carefully lift and remove bag from pan and let rest for at least 10 minutes before opening along top seam. 6. Use the drippings collected at the bottom of roasting bag to make a delicious gravy or sauce. Warning! Before cooking, do not lift roasting bag filled with ingredients as the bag can break. After cooking, use extreme caution when opening bag as the steam will be very hot. Tips & Advice: The bottom seam is designed to let steam out of the roasting bag during cooking and is not leakproof, so it is best not to fill the bag with too much liquid. For best results, place foods in center of bag and avoid over-filling After cooking, whisk a small amount of liquid and flour to the juices in the bag to make a delicious gravy or sauce. Easily prepare a "one pot meal" by roasting vegetables, such as onions, potatoes or carrots, with meats.

product.recipes: Coconut Chutney Ingredients: 300g Shana Shredded Coconut 2tsp. Coconut Oil 1 tsp. Mustard Seeds 6 small Onions (chopped) 1 inch Ginger 1 clove of Garlic 1 clove of Garlic (chopped) 1/2 Green Chilli (chopped) 1 pinch Asafoetida (Hing) 10 Curry Leaves 3 tbsp. Water 3 tsp. Salt Method: Defrost the Shana Shredded Coconut in a microwave for 5 - 10 minutes, or until it is defrosted. Put the shredded Coconut, 3 small chopped onions, ginger, garlic clove, green chilli, salt and curry leaves in food processor to create a paste. Add water to make the mixture more liquid. Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds. When the seeds start popping, add 3 chopped onions, curry leaves and chopped garlic. Cook them in high heat for 5 minutes. Mix in the chutney mixture and cook for 2 minutes on a high heat. Stir to mix well. Store in an airtight glass jar and refrigerate. Ideal accompaniments with this dish are Shana Parathas, Shana Chapattis or Shana Naans!

product.detailed_description: This textured striped towel will add an elegant finish to any bathroom. Made from responsibly sourced pure cotton, it is soft and absorbent and has been made with M&S' StayNew technology to keep it looking fresh wash after wash. This towel’s GSM rating is 500 GSM. GSM stands for grams per square metre and indicates the weight and density of the towel. M&S' towels range from 450-800 GSM. At the lower end of the scale, 450-600 GSM signifies a lightweight towel: good value and quick-drying, with added benefits such as low-twist yarn to make them feel more like their heavier-weight counterparts. At the higher end of the scale, 600-800 GSM signifies a heavier, more luxurious towel. The pile in these deluxe towels is denser and more lavish. Towels at the lower end of this range are great for everyday use, while those at the higher end resemble the towels you’d find in a luxury hotel.

product.detailed_description: This textured striped towel will add an elegant finish to any bathroom. Made from responsibly sourced pure cotton, it is soft and absorbent and has been made with M&S' StayNew technology to keep it looking fresh wash after wash. This towel’s GSM rating is 500 GSM. GSM stands for grams per square metre and indicates the weight and density of the towel. M&S' towels range from 450-800 GSM. At the lower end of the scale, 450-600 GSM signifies a lightweight towel: good value and quick-drying, with added benefits such as low-twist yarn to make them feel more like their heavier-weight counterparts. At the higher end of the scale, 600-800 GSM signifies a heavier, more luxurious towel. The pile in these deluxe towels is denser and more lavish. Towels at the lower end of this range are great for everyday use, while those at the higher end resemble the towels you’d find in a luxury hotel.

product.brand_marketing: We always like to say that everything you need to know about Jameson is right here - either on our bottle or in our bottle -encapsulating our full story. The label features our family crest and motto. Proclaiming ‘Sine Metu', it means ‘Without Fear'. It's the reason John Jameson first triple distilled Irish whiskey, creating Jameson Irish Whiskey as we know it. So in the spirit of Sine Metu, let us take you on a journey. Pull up a chair…
product.detailed_description: Jameson Irish whiskey is a triple-distilled blended Irish whiskey, as versatile as it is smooth. Whiskey like Jameson isn't just born smooth and balanced. First, we take the best of pot still and fine grain whiskeys. Then we triple distil them. Not because we have to, because we want to - this gives Jameson its signature smoothness. This tradition began in 1780 with John Jameson, and we continue his legacy to this day. Finally, we age our whiskey in oak casks for a minimum of 4 years. The result? A unique whiskey with a perfect balance of spicy, nutty and vanilla notes with hints of sweet sherry. Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week

Ingredients: 50ml Jameson Irish whiskey 1 bottle ginger ale 1 lime How to mix: Fill a high ball glass with ice, pour in a shot of Jameson, top up the glass with a good quality bottled ginger ale, stir briefly to mix, take a large wedge of lime, give it a squeeze and drop it into the glass. Roughly 1 part Jameson to 3 parts ginger ale, all parts refreshing.

product.brand_marketing: Sipsmith? Why Sipsmith? Well, much the same way wordsmiths love to create all things wordical, we love to create all things sippical. Like gin. It all began in 2009, in a tiny workshop in London. Three friends, Fairfax, Sam and Jared, had an unwavering belief in things well made - the way they used to be, the way they should be. So they set up London's first traditional copper distillery since 1820, with a mission to bring a London Dry Gin of truly uncompromising quality and character, back to the city where it first earned its name. It resulted in the sensationally sippable Sipsmith London Dry Gin. Bold, complex and aromatic -smooth enough for a Martini, yet rich and balanced, perfect for a G&T. Every bottle of Sipsmith is handcrafted in genuinely small batches. No regimented timings, no automatic cuts, just a craftsman's flair and a passion for gin well made.

product.detailed_description: Inspired by the coastal vitality of Salcombe and its shipbuilding heritage, award-winning Salcombe Gin ‘Start Point' is distilled in the iconic coastal town of Salcombe in the Southwest of England at one of the world's only distilleries directly accessible by boat. Drawing influence from the famous 19th century Salcombe Fruit Schooners and their precious cargo, Salcombe Gin use only the finest citrus fruits and spices, to create their multi-award winning collection of gins, each led by flavour and inspired by history. Named after the iconic ‘Start Point' lighthouse that marked the beginning of the 19th century voyages of the Salcombe Fruit Schooners who once carried the exotic goods, fruits and spices that inspire this gin's signature flavour. Tasting Notes: Salcombe Gin ‘Start Point' is a critically acclaimed citrus led London Dry gin distilled to the exacting one-shot London Dry method. This international multi-award winning gin is exceptionally smooth, distinct and complex yet extremely versatile. Distilled using only the finest Macedonian Juniper, English coriander seeds, fresh Mediterranean citrus peels and eight further hand sourced botanicals from around the world, blended together with pure, naturally soft Dartmoor water to create this perfectly balanced gin. ‘Start Point' has distinct notes of red grapefruit along with heady, earthy pine notes from the Macedonian juniper. It is perfectly balanced with warming spiced aromas on the nose. Rich, full and incredibly smooth on the palate, with a touch of earthy sweetness from liquorice and angelica root. The finish is fresh, lingering and balanced whilst lengthened by green cardamom. Best served: On its own over ice or with a premium tonic water garnished with a slice of red grapefruit to complement the rich and warm citrus notes. Alternatively try one of our ‘Start Point' signature serves and cocktails. Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week

product.brand_marketing: Salcombe Fruiters were Schooner sailing vessels built in Salcombe in the 1820s - 1880s. These ships were the fastest of their day, with copper sheathed hulls and an ability to sail close to the wind, hand built to carry cargos of highly perishable fresh fruits and spices from around the world to England's ports. The iconic 'Sainte Marie' lighthouse built in 1855, marks the Southern entrance to the Old Port of Marseille from which de Salcombe Fruiters would load citrus fruits and herbs from the Mediterranean. Harnessing the essence of these ships' precious cargo and their trading routes, we use only the finest fresh citrus fruits and spices combined with Macedonian Juniper, to create a contemporary spirit inspired by history.
product.detailed_description: Inspired by the coastal vitality of Salcombe and its shipbuilding heritage, multi-award winning Salcombe Gin ‘Rosé Sainte Marie' is distilled in the iconic coastal town of Salcombe in the Southwest of England at one of the world's only distilleries directly accessible by boat. ‘Rosé Sainte Marie' is a delicate, fresh and truly exquisite gin inspired by the aromas, flavours and lifestyle of the South of France and is a celebration of adventure, colour, freshness and joy; capturing the vibrant spirit of the Mediterranean coast. Named after the iconic ‘Sainte Marie' lighthouse which marks the Southern entrance to the Old Port of Marseille, from where 19th century Salcombe Fruit Schooners would load fresh citrus fruits and herbs bound for England's ports. This gin is one of only two ‘pink' gins in the world to have been awarded Double Gold at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition. More recently, was awarded a Double Gold at the 2020 SIP Awards. Tasting Notes: Distilled and crafted using the finest Macedonian juniper berries to provide structure in the background, partnered with a natural, but not overpowering soft sweetness from strawberries and angelica. Fresh citrus peels of lemon and orange which are hand peeled each day prior to distillation and combined with ten further hand-sourced botanicals including lavender, lemon verbena, rose petals, orange blossom and pink peppercorns are combined adding subtle finesse. On the palate it has fullness and intensity whilst remaining smooth with an endearing and lingering softness to finish. No added sugar or artificial colouring. It is purposefully dry in style. Naturally pink through the use of strawberries. Best served: On its own over ice or with a premium Indian tonic water and a slice of strawberry to accentuate the bouquet of red fruit or a twist of fresh lemon peel to bring the fragrant citrus to the fore. Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week

The Distillery, founded in 1866 by Mr. Jack Daniel in Lynchburg, Tennessee, is one of the most well-known producers of whiskey in the world. product.detailed_description: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 is a premium Tennessee Whiskey. A warm amber colour with aromas of sweet vanilla, this is a smooth, full-bodied whiskey, with flavours of orange, brown sugar and spice, and a long rich finish. Jack Daniel registered his distillery in 1866, making it the oldest registered distillery in the United States. It's here in Lynchburg that every drop of Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey is still produced and bottled today. During its 150 year history, Jack Daniel's has won numerous gold medals around the world. Its success can be put down to the unique way in which the famous 'Old No.7' brand is made, the same way it always has - using the finest corn, rye and barley malt; pure, iron-free water from the Cave Spring in the Distillery hollow; being mellowed through 10 feet of sugar maple charcoal; and aged in hand-crafted charred oak barrels. It is this unique way of making whiskey and the extra steps such as charcoal mellowing that makes Jack Daniel's what it is - a smooth sipping Tennessee whiskey and not a bourbon. product.brand_marketing: Inspired by an exceptional 8 year old tasted in the 1880s, Lagavulin 8 Year Old embodies the distillery's rich past. Revered by connoisseurs and experts, Lagavulin is known as "The King of Islay".
product.detailed_description: Lagavulin is one of the smokiest and most intense whiskies in the world. Since 1816, Lagavulin Single Malt Scotch Whisky has been made in a picturesque huddle of buildings on Lagavulin Bay looking onto Dunyvaig castle. Revered by connoisseurs and experts, Lagavulin is known as "The King of Islay". Originally a limited edition to celebrate Lagavulin's 200th anniversary, this 8 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky became a permanent favourite. Inspired by an exceptional 8 year old tasted in the 1880s, it embodies the distillery's rich past. Expect a complex symphony of flavours. The nose offers fragrant, tea-scented smoke with maritime hints, while the taste is a delightful dance of smoke, salted popcorn, honeyed nuts, and a touch of sweetness. A lingering warmth with hints of apple crumble and spice completes the experience. This award-winning single malt Scotch whisky is best enjoyed neat or with a drop of water to unlock its full potential. A touch of ice works too, if you prefer a lighter dram. This 8 year old Lagavulin is a perfect choice for those who enjoy peaty, smoky Scotches. It's a fantastic conversation starter or a luxurious nightcap. Whether you're a seasoned drinker or new to the world of single malts, the Lagavulin 8 Year Old is an exceptional dram waiting to be explored. Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week
product.features: ABOUT - Initially released as a limited edition offering for our 200th anniversary, and inspired by Britain’s most famous Victorian whisky writer Alfred Barnard, this special 8 year old Lagavulin was brought back full-time due to popular demand, HOW IT’S MADE - Made with slow distillation and heavily peated barley malt, Lagavulin 8 delivers intense flavours and a remarkable smoky nose, true to its Islay heritage, TASTING NOTES - Savour a delightful dance of flavours – sweetness gives way to a growing smokiness with hints of tea, a signature Lagavulin characteristic, SERVE - Enjoy this complex Scotch whisky neat, or unlock even more depth with a drop of water. A true connoisseur's dram, OCCASION - Celebrate life's moments with friends and loved ones. Lagavulin 8 Year Old is the perfect addition to any gathering, GIFTING - The ideal gift for everyone from whisky enthusiasts to connoisseurs complete with a presentation box
product.further_description: Lagavulin is one of the smokiest and most intense whiskies in the world. And it has even more richness to offer through deep sweetness and notes of dried fruits. Revered by connoisseurs and experts, it's known as “the king of Islay”. Situated in the romantic location of the beautiful island of Islay, the Lagavulin distillery looks onto Dunyvaig Castle. Released to commemorate the 200th anniversary of the founding of Lagavulin distillery by John Johnston in 1816, this eight-year-old Single Malt Scotch Whisky is big and smoky. A celebration of the people and craft that have made Lagavulin great over the last two centuries, its fragrant, tea-scented smoke alongside nose-drying, maritime aromas is unlocked with just a drop of water. Inspired by the visit of Alfred Barnard to the distillery in the 1880s when he tried an 'exceptionally fine' eight-year-old from the distillery, this is a fitting tribute for the milestone. With a light body that becomes pleasantly oily, the Lagavulin 8 Year Old palate boasts a magnificently full-on Lagavulin taste that's somehow even bigger than you expect. The clean, long finish is subtle with minted smoke and warming chocolate notes. The limited edition 8 Year Old calls for some special attention. Make time to enjoy neat in a whisky nosing glass, or with maybe just a drop of water. The limited edition, beautifully pristine presentation box makes it the perfect gift for lovers of peaty and powerful whiskies

product.brand_marketing: The Singleton of Dufftown is distilled in the Dufftown distillery of Speyside, where fine single malts have been produced since 1896. From fermentation to distillation, in every step of the production process, we have done the utmost to make this the best-tasting single malt whisky.
product.detailed_description: Experience the richness of Speyside, Scotland with the multi-award-winning Singleton of Dufftown 12 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky. A true labour of love, this whisky is an embodiment of our passion for crafting perfectly balanced, smooth, yet rich whisky. The whisky matures in a careful blend of American bourbon and European sherry casks, creating a harmonious balance that defines its unique character. This meticulous process results in an enticing aroma of toasted nuts, intertwined with rich fruit notes. On the palate, expect an accessible symphony of blackcurrant, brown sugar, and coffee – a flavour profile that has won Gold at the International Spirits Challenge and the San Francisco World Spirits Competition in 2022. The Singleton of Dufftown 12 Year Old is delicious neat or with ice, but its smooth, versatile flavour profile also pairs well with mixers like soda or apple juice for a refreshing-tasting whisky cocktail. It's the perfect gift for any special occasion, guaranteed to please both new and experienced single malt whisky drinkers. So whether you're new to the world of Scotch whisky or a seasoned connoisseur, indulge in the smooth, fruity, and balanced taste of The Singleton of Dufftown 12 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky. Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week

Designed with care and expertise, Bobbie Bunny is a teether that’s baby-sized, soft, and safe, making it the perfect companion for your little one’s teething journey. This versatile infant teether is ideal for teething babies and provides soothing comfort to your baby’s gums when teething. Comprehensive Teething Support: The textured feet, ears, and tail of this infant teether are ideal for soothing your baby's tooth and gum pain. Innovative Play and Development: Bobbie Bunny’s incredible Twist & Bounce tummy transforms teething time into a playful adventure. This unique feature of the Bobbie Bunny teething toy engages your baby’s senses and sparks motor development, making teething fun and beneficial. It also provides relief from their teething symptoms. Engaging Happy Face: Bobbie’s cheerful face is designed to captivate and appeal to both babies and toddlers, ensuring endless giggles and smiles, making it the perfect teething toy! Silicone Bristles: The specially designed silicone bristles of this teething toy provide a base for hygienic application of baby teething gel, as well as introducing your baby to early brushing habits. Easy to Hold: Bobbie Bunny’s lightweight and easy to grip design makes it perfect for little hands. The teether also helps to promote dexterity and supports play and motor skill development. Hygienic and Safe: This baby teether is made from non-toxic, soft, food-grade silicone. Bobbie Bunny is BPA, PVC, phthalate-free as well as being FDA-approved, UKCA & CE certified. product.brand_marketing: Mutti Tomatoes is a premium Italian brand known for its rich, authentic, and flavourful tomato-based products. With over 125 years of expertise, Mutti offers a range of high-quality tomato products, from purees to chopped tomatoes, crafted from sun-ripened, Italian-grown tomatoes. The brand is synonymous with excellence, innovation, and sustainability, placing a strong emphasis on using eco-friendly farming practices and supporting local agriculture. Mutti's commitment to superior taste, ethical sourcing, and environmental responsibility has made it a trusted name in kitchens worldwide. Whether you're a home cook or a professional chef, Mutti promises to deliver the perfect balance of quality, flavour, and tradition in every product. Spaghetti with tomato cream and burrata cheese Ingredients for 4 people: 200g spaghetti 300g Mutti Passata Tuscany 150g burrata cheese 20g olive oil 1 clove garlic 2 tablespoons Parmigiano Reggiano t.t. salt t.t. pepper Method: Cook the spaghetti in plenty of salted boiling water. In a pan, gently sauté the garlic in a drizzle of olive oil, then add the Mutti Passata Tuscany. Season with salt and pepper and let it simmer for a few minutes. Blend the tomato sauce together with the burrata until smooth. Return the creamy sauce to the pan, add the spaghetti (cooked al dente), and toss everything together. Add a few tablespoons of pasta cooking water and two tablespoons of grated Parmesan cheese to help it all come together. Serve hot.

With no added preservatives or artificial ingredients, it's pure, simple, and full of authentic Italian goodness. product.recipes: Buttery Pastry case. 20cm Pastry case Craft perfect pastry cases and make comforting pies filled with your favourite fillings. 175g Plain Flour 80g cold butter, diced Pinch of salt 2-4 tbsp water Oven 200°C / Fan 180°C / Gas Mark 6 1. Sift the flour and salt into a large mixing bowl, add the diced butter to the flour and using fingertips, lightly rub into the flour until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. 2. Add roughly 2 tablespoons of cold water, then use a round bladed knife to start to bringing the mixture together. Add more water if needed, then finally bring the mixture together with your hands to form a smooth ball of dough. 3. Wrap the pastry in a piece of clingfilm and rest in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Meanwhile preheat oven. 4. Roll out the pastry to fit the size of your dish and line with greaseproof paper. Fill with baking beans and bake in a preheated oven for 15 minutes. 5. Remove baking beans and greaseproof paper. Cook for a further 5 minutes. 6. Trim off the excess pastry with a sharp knife and use pastry case as required.

product.brand_marketing: Made from 100% blue weber agave harvested in the rich clay soil of Mexico, this tequila reflects authentic aged tequila craftsmanship.
product.detailed_description: Crafted from 100% blue weber agave sourced from the rich clay soils of Mexico, Casamigos Reposado is a testament to meticulous tequila-making. Our Reposado undergoes a slow and careful production process, where the agave piñas are expertly roasted in traditional brick ovens to enhance their natural flavours. The tequila presents a stunning golden honey colour, inviting you to discover the depth of its well-rounded profile. The aroma of Casamigos Reposado is rich with caramel and hints of cocoa, setting the stage for a flavour palette that delicately balances notes of dried fruits and spicy oak. A touch of sweet agave rounds out the tasting experience, providing a subtle reminder of its pure origins. With a silky texture that glides effortlessly across the palate, Casamigos Reposado delivers a medium to long smooth finish that is both soft and slightly oaky. Whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as the key ingredient in a refined cocktail, Casamigos Reposado offers an elegant, flavour-rich experience that enhances any drinking occasion. Discover the craftsmanship and sublime taste of Casamigos Reposado. Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week
product.features: ULTRA-PREMIUM REPOSADO TEQUILA - Casamigos, founded by George Clooney and Rande Gerber, was born out of a desire to craft the perfect tequila, TASTING NOTES - This aged tequila is soft and slightly oaky with hints of caramel and cocoa, offering a silky texture and a smooth finish, HOW IT'S MADE - Crafted from hand-selected 100% blue weber agave from the heart of Mexico, ensuring genuine tequila quality. This reposado tequila is aged in oak barrels, enhancing its flavour profile and smoothness, HOW TO ENJOY - Enjoy this tequila neat, on the rocks, or as a tequila cocktail in Margaritas, Palomas, or Old Fashioned, OCCASION - Perfect for parties, gatherings, and special occasions, elevating any event with its ultra-premium quality
product.ingredients: TEQUILA
product.manufacturer: DIAGEO Germany GmbH, Reeperbahn 1, 20359 Hamburg, Deutschland
product.name: Casamigos Reposado Tequila
product.recipes: CASA MARGARITA: 50ml Casamigos Reposado Tequila 25ml fresh lime juice 15ml fresh orange juice 15ml agave nectar Some ice ½ thick rim equal parts salt / sugar / orange zest (optional) Garnish with lime wheel Wet ½ the rim of a rocks glass with lime wheel or wedge, then dip into salt mixture. Combine all ingredients into a tine shaker. Add ice, shake vigorously and strain into a small rocks glass. Add fresh ice and garnish.

product.detailed_description: Give your baby the softest start with Pura’s new and improved, comfiest ever nappies, designed to gently protect delicate newborn skin. Multi-award winning, these disposable nappies feature a super-absorbent core with stay-dry channels that quickly lock moisture away from delicate skin. As a proud B Corp, Pura is committed to caring for the planet. Pura’s new nappies are wrapped in a paper pack, freshly designed to feature Pura’s spokesbabies. Tackling nappy waste, Pura NappiCycle already recycles 60 million nappies annually and is working hard to achieve a national roll-out. Loved and trusted by parents, Pura nappies have an impressive list of awards from Mother and Baby, Loved by Parents, Made for Mums and many others. A super-absorbent core with stay-dry channels locks liquid away, while a breathable layer made with plant-based materials promotes airflow to help protect against nappy rash. • HYPOALLERGENIC NAPPIES FOR SENSITIVE SKIN. Totally chlorine-free and made without fragrance, lotion, or natural rubber latex. Dermatologically tested and OEKO-TEX® Standard 100 certified. • THOUGHTFULLY MADE NAPPIES. Made with more plant-based materials, produced responsibly and packed in recyclable paper and where available, recycled through Pura NappiCycle.
