product.detailed_description: We compress recycled waste wood at high pressure to create these hexagonal briquettes. Completely natural and made without binders, so 100% natural. Resin in the wood binds the sawdust together which is then carbonized into charcoal. This creates an ultra consistent briquette that burns extremely cleanly. With a central hole to aid air flow, the burn is even across the barbecue. With cooking times of up to 4 hours it's our longest lasting charcoal. Hot Brix are also consistent and predictable on how they perform making it the ideal fuel for professional kitchens or keen home barbecuer looking for ultimate flavour and performance.

product.other_information: Safety Warning: WARNING CARBON MONOXIDE HAZARD Burning charcoal inside can kill you. It gives off carbon monoxide, which has no odour. NEVER burn charcoal inside homes, vehicles or tents. For indoor commercial applications, permanent extraction/ventilation must be provided. Additional Information: FSC - FSC® 100%, Wood from well-managed forests, FSC® C007000, www.fsc.org
product.preparation_and_usage: To light: Light some standard lumpwood charcoal in the normal way. Once lit, add the Hot Brix on top of the hot charcoal. The heat will spread through the Hot Brix and will be ready to cook on in approximately 30 minutes. Alternatively: Heap Hot Brix in a pile on top of a bed of firelighters. Use extra lighters compared to lumpwood charcoal. Once the Hot Brix have turned grey spread them evenly across the barbecue. Allow approximately 45 minutes before the Hot Brix are ready to cook on using this method. Top Tip: Mixing Hot Brix with lumpwood charcoal gives a great combination of flavour and long-lasting burn time.

product.detailed_description: HOW DOES IT WORK? Looking for pain relief patches for sprains, strains and bruises on your arm or leg? Discover Voltarol ONE A DAY Muscle Pain Relief Medicated Plaster and get in on the joy of movement again. Unlike heat patches, the plaster contains the anti-inflammatory ingredient diclofenac sodium which helps treat pain at its source. To fight the pain locally, the anti-inflammatory ingredient penetrates in to the skin. During application of one plaster, diclofenac is continuously released from the plaster all day to help fight pain and reduce inflammation and swelling. 1. Voltarol ONE A DAY Muscle Pain Relief Medicated Plaster contains diclofenac sodium. Always read the label 2. EFFECTIVE PAIN RELIEF IN A PATCH: Effective for strains, sprains and bruises on the arms and legs 3. MAXIMUM ONE MEDICATED PLASTER ONCE DAILY: even if there is more than one injured area to be treated 4. UP TO 24HRS CONTINUOUS RELEASE: Get up to 24 hours release of the potent anti-inflammatory agent to relieve pain and inflammation 5. HELPS TREAT PAIN AT ITS SOURCE: To fight the pain locally, the anti-inflammatory ingredient penetrates in to the skin 6. ONCE A DAY APPLICATION: With a one application you can get up to 24 hours pain relief

product.preparation_and_usage: Our plasters are simple to use. Just follow the steps below To apply the plaster: 1.Cut the sachet along the dotted line and remove the medicated plaster 2.Remove one of the two protective films. 3.Apply to the area to be treated and remove the remaining protective film. 4.Apply slight pressure with the palms of your hand until complete adhesion to the skin is achieved. To remove the plaster: 1.Moisten the plaster with water and peel away an edge of the plaster and pull smoothly away from the skin. 2.To remove any product residues, wash the affected area with water gently rubbing the area with your fingers using a circular movement. The maximum daily dose of Voltarol medicated plaster is one plaster per day.

It is aged in curated Tennessee Whiskey barrels until reaching remarkable depth of flavour. Our Anejo is rich with a long finish, perfect for sipping & sharing with good friends & family. THE BOTTLE: Meticulously crafted to embody the elegance & sophistication of the spirit within. The bottle’s unique 5-sided glass structure pays homage to the 5 founders. A standout feature is the distinctive 23-degree angle, a tribute to Michael Jordan’s iconic jersey number, symbolizing greatness & a relentless drive to be the best. AGED: Over 20 months AROMA: Fresh-cut oak wood; maple, dried fruits, cinnamon, and nutmeg TASTE: Cooked agave, toasted oak, maple, dark chocolate, and baking spices FINISH: Long and complex; evolving wood notes Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week

product.other_information: REACH FOR GREATNESS: In July 2016, five rival NBA team owners - Emilia Fazzalari and Wyc Grousbeck of the Celtics, Jeanie Buss of the Lakers, Michael Jordan of the Hornets, and Wes Edens of the Bucks - met for dinner. That night, they bonded over their shared love for tequila and Cincoro was born. Combining "cinco" for five and "oro" for gold, Cincoro symbolizes their mission of creating the gold standard in tequila. Cincoro Tequila is uniquely made with 100% Weber Blue agave from private farms in both the highland and lowland regions of Jalisco, Mexico. The agave is hand-selected and slow-cooked in a small batch process, distilling the highland and lowland tequilas separately, before blending them together to create the Cincoro signature taste profile. This is the heart of Cincoro: a naturally rich and delicious family of tequilas that are smooth on the palate with a complex, long finish. Cincoro Tequila is a taste experience unlike any other, created to be sipped neat, but also to elevate cocktails.

product.brand_marketing: Founded in Dufftown, Scotland by William Grant and his family with a vision to create ‘The best dram in the valley', Glenfiddich first flowed from the stills on Christmas Day, 1887. The family's pioneering spirit has seen Glenfiddich excel for over a hundred and thirty years. In 1963 it started actively marketing outside of Scotland, effectively creating the single malt category as it exists today. Glenfiddich is the world's most awarded Single Malt Scotch Whisky* but its heart remains in the Highlands. The Robbie Dhu spring still flows through the distillery as it did when William Grant and his family built it. The granite stones still stand as strong as they did in 1887. The spirit is as inspired today as it was when it first flowed from the stills over a century ago.
product.detailed_description: Introducing Glenfiddich 14 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Reserve, Single Malt Scotch Whisky. This indulgent single malt delivers the smooth sophistication of Scotland, with the sweet kick of American bourbon. A superb dram for lovers of both single malt Scotch whisky and premium American whiskeys. The 14 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Reserve is Glenfiddich's first whisky matured in two types of American oak barrel. The ex-bourbon casks are the bedrock, giving an indulgent richness and sweetness after our malt master, Brian Kinsman, waits 14 years as the whisky matures. He then shakes it awake in deep-charred new oak barrels for a vivid and vibrant punch of vanilla, adding extra layers of richness and complexity. Vivid, rich and vibrant, the taste of Glenfiddich 14 Year Old Bourbon Barrel: - Colour: Copper Oak. - Nose: Deep vibrant vanilla notes with hints of citrus, caramalised brown sugar and cinnamon. Baked apple and ripe summer fruits and balanced with the rich Oaky aromas. - Taste: Beautifully rich and sweet with layers of creamy toffee, woody spices, candied orange peel and fresh toasted oak. - Finish: Long lasting with lingering sweetness. Rich, Sweet Sophistication: Experience the unique blend of Scotland and American bourbon with Glenfiddich 14 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Reserve. This single malt whisky is matured in ex-bourbon casks and finished in deep-charred new oak barrels for a rich, vibrant taste with layers of vanilla, brown sugar, and fresh pear. Exquisite Flavor Profile: Indulge in the beautifully rich and sweet flavors of Glenfiddich 14 Year Old. Enjoy notes of creamy toffee, woody spices, candied orange peel, and fresh toasted oak, culminating in a long-lasting, lingering sweetness that whisky connoisseurs will adore. Unmatched Craftsmanship: Our malt master, Brian Kinsman, carefully matures this whisky for 14 years in American oak casks, then finishes it in charred new oak barrels, enhancing its complexity and depth. The result is a vivid and vibrant whisky that stands out among single malts. Award-Winning Legacy: Glenfiddich is the world's most awarded single malt Scotch whisky, celebrated for its pioneering spirit and commitment to excellence. Our 14 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Reserve exemplifies this legacy with its unparalleled quality and craftsmanship. product.brand_marketing: "Ukiyo" means "floating world" symbolising living in the moment, detached from the difficulties of life. Featuring high quality native ingredients, Ukiyo brings a unique taste of Japan that transports you to a moment of sheer perfection that ultimately stirs the senses. UKIYO Japanese spirits are born in Chiba east of Tokyo and are made with rice that is masterfully distilled into our Gin and Vodka expressions. We begin with a base of the finest quality spirit made with locally grown rice, a celebration of Japan's most recognised harvest. This native ingredient lends a distinct balance and elevated textural mouthfeel to our gins. We distill with 11 botanicals focusing on 5 native Japanese flavours. Juniper | Yuzu Peel | Mikan Peel | Sakura Flower | Sakura Leaf | Sansho Pepper | Coriander | Angelica Root | Lemon Peel | Cardamon | Rosemary. The result is a range of masterfully distilled Japanese Gins that celebrate the three core gin profiles: Classic, Floral & Citrus. UKIYO is a B-Corp certified brand.
product.detailed_description: Discover the vibrant and refreshing flavours of Ukiyo Yuzu Citrus Gin, a remarkable gin that captures the essence of Japanese yuzu citrus. Crafted with meticulous care, this gin infuses the classic gin botanicals with the bright and zesty flavours of yuzu, creating a unique and invigorating drinking experience. With its crystal-clear appearance and enticing aromas, Ukiyo Yuzu Citrus Gin entices the senses. On the palate, it delights with a burst of citrusy goodness, featuring the tangy and aromatic notes of yuzu alongside the classic juniper and botanicals. Whether enjoyed in traditional gin cocktails or mixed with your favorite citrus-inspired creations, Ukiyo Yuzu Citrus Gin is the perfect choice for those seeking a refreshing and uplifting gin experience. Immerse yourself in the vibrant and zesty world of Ukiyo Yuzu Citrus Gin and let it transport you to a world of Japanese citrus bliss with every sip. Yuzu is a citrus fruit that is cultivated and beloved within Japan. Visually similar to a lemon but with a powerful fragrance, unique herbal notes, mild bitterness, and a less sharp acid flavour. UKIYO Japanese Yuzu Gin won a silver medal in the London Spirits Competition 2025 and gold in 2024. The judges said: ”Complex gin with pronounced herbal notes, balanced palate, and long citrus finish. Menthol aroma with bergamot and citrus flavours, refreshing and perfumed.” “Bursting with yuzu and jasmine aromas, this citrus-forward spirit offers a silky texture, floral lift, and a lingering London-style finish that feels clean and modern.” UKIYO Japanese Yuzu Gin has a striking two-colour ombré bottle that reflects the mountains and seas of Japan and symbolises the Japanese art of perfection making it a perfect gift for parties, birthdays, Valentine's or Christmas. Tasting Notes: Principal notes: juniper, yuzu citrus, bitter orange, coriander Background notes: pine, lavender, matcha tea Serving suggestions: To fully stir the senses, serve UKIYO Japanese Yuzu Gin over ice with premium tonic or soda water and a slice of lemon or why not try in a cocktail. UKIYO Japanese Yuzu Gin “Gimlet” cocktail 60ml Ukiyo Yuzu Gin 30ml Lime Juice 20ml Lime Syrup Shake all the ingredients with ice, discard the ice and strain into a martini glass to serve. Garnish with a sprig of mint. UKIYO Japanese Yuzu Gin “Paradise” cocktail 60ml Ukiyo Yuzu Gin 25ml Apricot Brandy 25ml Orange Juice 2 dashes of Orange Bitters Shake all the ingredients with ice, discard the ice and strain into a martini glass to serve. Complete with a twist of orange. Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week

product.detailed_description: Ocado Kitchen Foil 10m x 300mm approx. Kitchen foil, (also known as aluminium foil), is a household essential that can be used in virtually every stage of food handling, from preparation and cooking to storage and serving. It's ideal for wrapping meat (like roasts or turkey) to keep them moist and tender during cooking or, placed loosely over food during roasting to prevent the top from burning. Food like fish, vegetables, or chicken can be wrapped in foil parcels to steam and cook on the barbecue, keeping the food moist and infusing it with flavour. Use it to line baking trays and grill pans to prevent food from sticking or falling through, making cleaning up a breeze. It's a quick and easy way to wrap and store leftovers in the fridge and can be used to wrap food tightly before freezing to prevent freezer burn. From film to foil to freezer bags and everything in between, we've got all the necessities you need to keep those kitchen drawers topped up, simply search 'Ocado household'.

product.other_information: Warning: Keep out of reach of children. Pack contains sharp cutting edge. Not suitable for use in microwaves. Keep foil away from electric heating elements and naked flames. Do not allow foil to come into contact with acidic foods such as citrus fruits. Do not store food in a metal container covered with foil. Lightly coat foil with oil prior to cooking or storing food containing salt. To avoid the spread of bacteria, do not re-use foil.
product.preparation_and_usage: Directions for Use: 1. To open, rip off tear strip. 2. Push in the end tabs to hold roll in place. 3. Pull the desired length and tear against the sharp cutting edge. Always store the roll in the box. Ideal for covering food when cooking or roasting for insulation, lining grill pans & barbecues, wrapping and storing food. Clean foil prior to recycling.

product.brand_marketing: This wine originates from the gravelly sandy loam valley floor of Turckheim. In 2022, the crop was particularly small due to important losses during flowering and very small berries, consequence of a dry and hot summer. Usually, the oldest vines go into the Roche Roulée cuvée, but in 2022, both wines were blended together in a smaller cask. A high skin/juice ratio can explain the intense aromatic profile of this wine. The lack of water also slowed down the sugar ripeness. Despite waiting longer than usual, the sugar ripeness stayed low while the skins continued to ripen. This is the only Riesling that fermented quickly in 2022 and ended completely dry.

product.serving_suggestions: Pale yellow clear colour. The nose is delicately perfumed, Riesling can be quite flowery, and this wine shows it well. The lacy texture is already apparent on the nose, showing a medium intensity without the stony/mineral signature of more serious vineyard. The palate is immediately enjoyable: light, elegant, juicy, uncomplicated. It is a bone-dry wine with an easy drinkable mouthfeel. To be enjoyed now!
product.vinification_details: They emphasise expressing terroir (soil, aspect, microclimate) through minimal intervention: slow fermentations, lees aging, minimal manipulation, allowing the soil and site to come through. The Riesling Turckheim from Zind-Humbrecht is made with hand-harvested grapes, gently whole-cluster pressed, and fermented spontaneously with native yeasts in large old oak foudres, where fermentations can last for months at natural cellar temperatures. The wine then ages on its full lees in the same casks for 12–18 months without fining or chaptalisation, and with only minimal sulfur additions before bottling. This slow, low-intervention approach preserves purity of fruit, freshness, and a clear expression of Turckheim’s gravelly alluvial soils.

product.detailed_description: Spontex Sponge Cloths are super absorbent and stop odours. The cloths are treated with an antibacterial agent* that limits the development of bacteria and bad smells in them. These thick, flexible sponge cloths are perfect for mopping up spills and wiping down surfaces. Reinforced with a cotton mesh they are also resistant and long lasting. Cloth size approx. 19.4 x 18cm. Assorted colours, mixed pack. Did you know? These sponge cloths are made from cellulose, an ultra thirsty material, which means that each cloth can absorb 13 times its own dry weight in water. Spontex Sponge Cloths are made from cellulose and cotton which are plant based materials and compostable.** 50% of the cotton used is recycled. They are durable and can be used multiple times, just pop them in the washing machine between uses. 100% of the wood pulp used is PEFC Certified and comes from sustainably managed forests and controlled sources. The packaging now uses 29% less plastic compared to the previous pack, meaning we are using 55kg less plastic for every 100,000 packs. Top Tip: These cloths come in a mixed colour pack so why not dedicate a specific colour to a specific task or room. *The sponge cloth is treated with an antibacterial product: didecyldimethylammonium chloride that kills 99% of E. coli bacteria present in it. **The sponge cloth is compostable in domestic compost bins, based on tests conducted by an independent laboratory. Dispose of in a suitable compost bin only.

Dove body + mind Body Wash is designed to transform your daily shower into a moment of reset, combining indulgent sensorial fragrances with skincare‑inspired care. Enriched with antioxidant‑rich ingredients, this serum body wash gently cleanses while helping skin feel visibly soft and glowing, helping you revive both body and mind. It's also free from sulphate SLES, has 99%* biodegradable ingredients, is packaged in 100% recycled plastic bottles** and is PETA-approved Vegan. To get the most from Dove body + mind Body Wash, squeeze a generous amount into your palms or onto a shower puff. Massage onto wet skin, taking a moment to enjoy the rich lather and sensorial fragrance as you cleanse. Rinse thoroughly with warm water to reveal skin that feels soft, smooth and refreshed. Use daily to transform your shower into a calming, feel‑good ritual for both body and mind. The cared-for feeling you have after using this moisturising body wash is one of a kind. To make it last as long as possible, invest in some big, fluffy towels. This is all about making moments to switch off from the outside world, and wrapping yourself in something soft and lavish is the perfect final touch. At Dove, our vision is of a world where beauty is a source of confidence, and not anxiety. product.detailed_description: Seraquin® Digest is a delicious paste for both dogs and cats that contains naturally sourced, science‐supported ingredients to help balance your pet’s tummy, support healthy digestion and firm up loose stool. Backed by 140 years of pet care experience, this supplement contains both probiotics and prebiotics. It’s packed with a high concentration of E. faecium, a naturally present probiotic that’s clinically shown to help dogs with gut trouble. The prebiotic helps to promote the growth of the good bacteria in the gut while also stopping bad bacteria from flourishing. Seraquin® Digest includes a unique type of clay called bentonite, which works to enhance poo consistency and support cats and dogs with upset tummies. This clay has a unique structure that makes it ideal for binding and removing bad bacteria, viruses and toxins. Especially useful during periods of stress, antibiotic treatment or other challenges that might upset the natural bacterial flora in the gut and result in loose stool. Use for as long as considered necessary or directed by the veterinary surgeon, but no longer than four weeks. product.detailed_description: Experience long lasting soothing comfort with the VoltaHeat Pain Relief Patch from the Voltarol Family. Offering up to 16 hours of therapeutic heat. Each patch provides deep, penetrating warmth for up to 8 hours, with the lasting effects of low level heat therapy continuing for up to 16 hours after removal. Using consistent heat at around 40°C, the patch delivers deep penetrating heat to help relieve pain and soothe stiff, tense or aching muscles. The continuous warming action helps relax muscle tensions, stiffness, aches and pains, supporting movement throughout your day. Designed for targeted pain relief, the patch works directly where it's applied. It is recommended for back pain and muscular aches and pains, making it suitable for daily stiffness or discomfort in areas like the back, neck or shoulders. VoltaHeat Pain Relief Patch is non-medicated and odourless providing consistent, continuous heat delivering comforting warmth. Simple to use, apply the patch to affected area and allow the deep warming sensation to provide targeted relief. VoltaHeat Pain Relief Warming Patch - FEEL THE HEAT. 1. UP TO 16* HOURS WARMING RELIEF: *8 hours warming effect. Long lasting pain relief and therapeutic benefit of continuous low-level heat therapy, extended up to 16 hours after patch removal. 2. DEEP PENETRATING HEAT TO RELIEVE PAIN: Delivers deep, penetrating heat to help relieve pain and soothe stiff or tense muscles. 3. RELAXES MUSCLE TENSION & ACCELERATES RECOVERY: Continuous low level heat helps relax muscle tensions, stiffness, aches and pains, supporting natural movement. 4. TARGETED PAIN RELIEF: Designed to deliver warming relief directly where it's applied. Recommended for back pain and muscular aches and pains. 5. CONSISTENT, CONTINUOUS HEAT: Provides steady, comforting warmth at approximately 40°C for effective relief. 6. NON-MEDICATED RELIEF: Offers drug-free soothing warming comfort.

Smirnoff No. 21 also makes a perfect aperitif such as the Espresso Martini - simply add 35ml Smirnoff, 25ml Espresso, 25ml coffee liquor, sugar syrup and cubed ice to a shaker and mix. Together Health’s naturally-fermented, stable form of CoQ10 is cultured from good bacteria, so it’s easy for you to digest and absorb. product.recipes: Smashed Avocado Toast with Balsamic-roasted Cherry Tomatoes By Ocado Prep time: 5 mins Cook time: 20 mins Serves: 4 Ingredients: 335g of cherry tomatoes, halved 0.5 red onion, thinly sliced 2tsp of balsamic glaze 1tbsp of olive oil 0.5tsp of chilli flakes 2 large avocados 1tsp of lemon juice, plus extra to serve 1tsp of lime juice 1 pinch of sea salt 4 slices of sourdough bread, toasted Method Step 1 Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan/gas mark 6. In a medium bowl, combine the cherry tomatoes, red onion, balsamic glaze, olive oil, chilli flakes and a generous pinch of salt and pepper. Transfer to a deep baking tray and roast in the oven for 20 mins. After 15 mins, make a start on the smashed avocado. Step 2 Halve the ripe avocados and scoop out the flesh into a bowl. Mash with a fork until your desired consistency is achieved, then add the lemon and lime juice and season with sea salt and black pepper to taste. Spread the smashed avocado onto 4 thick slices of toasted sourdough, top with a generous spoonful of the roasted cherry tomatoes and finish with a gentle squeeze of lemon juice if desired.

product.detailed_description: Montelobos is an unaged joven mezcal, crafted from meticulously, cultivated organic Espadin, which is roasted underground and small-batch distilled to achieve a ideal balance of sweetness and subtle smoke. Montelobos Espadín is distilled from 100% organic agave espadín, grown in the shadow of Oaxaca’s Mountain of Wolves. The climate stresses the agave just enough to make it the best in the world for producing mezcal. We rotate our crops consistently and only select an agave once it’s reached maturity—up to ten years of age. For Montelobos the key to flavour — the key to mezcal itself — is balance. Much like tequila, the perfect mezcal rests inside a web of balanced flavour, elevated and made whole by the traditions of the past. Montelobos has the peculiar ability to evolve between sipping, making it a unique experience to discover again and again. The green notes from the agave botanicals, the sweet and caramel-like notes from the roasted piñas, and finally, the smoky notes that come from the pit all are expressed in a multilayered, multidimensional experience. product.brand_marketing: Le Philtre Organic Vodka is more than just a spirit—it's an eco-conscious celebration bottled at 40% ABV in Cognac, France. Made solely from organic soft winter wheat and Gensac® spring water—this vodka is distilled six times including a final distillation in a traditional Charentais copper still, where a few drops of oak distillate are added. This demanding French craftsmanship preserves the purity of the spirit while shaping a sipping vodka with a subtle and distinctive aromatic profile. Aromatic on the nose with delicate toasted almond and tonka bean notes, the palate offers creamy vanilla and milky layering, culminating in a soft yet structured finish. Its eco-designed packaging, crafted from recycled coloured glass, gives each bottle a unique look—part art, part sustainability statement. Whether served chilled neat or elevated in a minimalist highball, Le Philtre embodies the spirit of “joyful ecology”—luxury made thoughtful, savour-able, and sustainable.
product.detailed_description: Le Philtre is equally at home on its own as it is rewriting the classics. Pure, refined and endlessly versatile. NEAT: Best enjoyed between 6°C and 8°C to reveal its elegant texture and delicate flavours. IN COCKTAILS: From the Martini and Bloody Mary to the Espresso Martini, it brings a distinctly French twist to every classic—and inspires signature serves of its own. You can try Le Philtre d'Amour, the original signature cocktail. A thoughtfully composed cocktail, where every ingredient has its role to play. Le Philtre Vodka: 45ml Cherry cream: 10ml Giffard Rose Syrup: 5ml Raspberry Nectar: 20ml Verjuice OR grape juice: 20ml Foamer dash: 2 - Pour all ingredients into a shaker filled with iceShake vigorously to chill the mixture well - Remove the ice and perform a dry shake - Double strain into an ice-filled Le Philtre low tumbler - Place a rose petal in the centre of the glass and spritz with geranium hydrosol Le Philtre Vodka reinvents the espresso martini by breaking the rules. Less sugar but more subtlety, Vanilla and grated tonka bean add a touch of indulgence and comfort. Le Philtre Vodka: 40ml Sobacha & vanilla syrup OR vanilla syrup: 20ml Fresh coffee: 40ml Foamer dash: 2 - Pour all ingredients into a shaker filled with ice - Shake vigorously to chill the mixture well - Double strain into a chilled cocktail glass - Grate the tonka bean over only one half of the foam using a microplane Served on a silver tray alongside a croissant — an irreverent nod to France's beloved coffee-and-croissant ritual. Please drink responsibly: The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week

product.further_description: Enjoy responsibly, drink sustainably. At Le Philtre, we believe caring for the planet should be something to celebrate. Behind our light-hearted spirit lies a genuine commitment: to build a vodka brand that is truly responsible, without ever compromising on pleasure. From the design of our bottle to the way we distil, from sourcing our ingredients to our 'In Philtration' parties, everything we create is held to the same exacting standards. It may sound a little serious—and perhaps it is. But since 2020, we've been celebrating ""joyful ecology"" the way we know best: dancing on tables with a glass of Le Philtre in hand.

product.manufacturer_marketing: Le Philtre’s bottle is crafted from recycled glass waste. Its stoppers, made from oak offcuts and marked by subtle imperfections, embody the very same philosophy. Designed to be kept, the bottle naturally becomes a decorative object: we encourage everyone to reuse the bottle and to transform it into vase or a lamp!

product.brand_marketing: Del Monte’s story began in California in the late nineteenth century when a small group of growers set out to bring ripe flavourful fruit to families across America. Their dedication to careful farming, honest produce and dependable quality helped Del Monte grow into one of the most recognised food brands in the world. Today Del Monte is the UK’s number one fruit brand and the leading name in peaches, pineapple, mixed fruits, mandarin, prunes and pears. We work closely with long standing growers who respect the land, harvesting fruit at its natural peak and preparing it with the same care that has defined Del Monte for more than a century. Quality guides every stage of our process. Fruit is picked when flavour and texture are at their best and packed promptly to protect its natural goodness. Many of our grower partnerships have lasted for decades, helping us maintain consistent standards and support responsible farming from orchard through to packing. Our commitment to people and planet is reflected in our sustainability work which supports farming communities, protects natural resources and drives continual improvement across our supply chain. For us, good food begins at the source. Del Monte exists to bring real fruit, real flavour and real care to your table, just as we have done for generations.

Now low in sugar and containing eight vital vitamins, chosen especially to support the wellbeing of young people, this one-a-day Holland and Barrett Kids Multi Gummy is a yummy - and easy - alternative to tablets, helping kids to get that good stuff without any arguments. Whether your child is a fussy eater, burns through energy with constant action or seems like their immune health could do with some additional support, taking this chewy vitamin gummy as an after-breakfast treat sets them up for a day of learning and playing. As well as helping them to maintain the energy levels they need to keep their brain, immune system, and the rest of their body, working as it should. Vitamins for vision and energy Kids are bombarded with information every minute of every day, from the television they watch to the lessons they take in school. This means that those little brains are constantly ticking over and eyes are always in use, taking in information from the world around them. Included in Holland and Barrett's gummy vitamins for kids, vitamin A is essential for the maintenance of normal healthy vision and Vitamin D is needed for normal growth and development of bone in children. Kids of all ages need all the energy they can get. From play time to dance class, Saturday morning football to after school playdates, our little ones are always on the move. Helping small bodies to convert the food they eat into the energy they need to play hard, B vitamins, including B6, B5 and niacin support your child's energy production in a healthy, balanced way. We've also added vitamin B12 to ensure children are getting enough energy throughout the day as well as helping to reduce tiredness and fatigue, so to get the most from their childhood adventures! Immunity support for kids Packed into classrooms, soft play centres and changing rooms together, kids swap germs faster and more efficiently than Pokemon collectors' cards. We all know that germs can be a good thing, helping us to build strong immunity, but ensuring good levels of vital immunity-supporting nutrients is essential too. Vitamin C and vitamin D are required for a healthy immune system. However, both can be hard to come by naturally, which is why the NHS (along with other worldwide health organisations) recommends that young children are supplied with a supplement. Multivitamins and growth We've added a blend of vitamins and minerals to support the healthy development of children from top to toe, aiding the growth of bones that stand up to constant tumbles.

product.recipes: A Recipe for French Toast (a.k.a. eggy bread) Ingredients 4 Slices of white bread 4 Eggs 30g Melted butter, plus a large knob of butter for frying 3 tbsp sugar Dash of milk, about 40ml Small pinch of ground nutmeg, clove and cinnamon Pinch of salt Method 1. Whisk together the eggs, milk, spices, salt and melted butter. 2. Pour the mix into a shallow casserole dish and submerge your bread slices to get an even coating on both sides. Leave the slices in for 1 minute max so they don't fall apart. 3. Over a medium heat, add some butter to a pan. Once sizzling, lay your soaked slices in the pan and leave to sizzle for a couple of minutes undisturbed. Once the bread has turned golden brown, flip it over and repeat. 4. Serve with bacon, berries, crème fraîche, maple syrup, or whatever else you fancy.

product.brand_marketing: Alma by Natoora Rye Loaf A deeply flavoursome wholemeal rye with rich natural sweetness. Rye generally has a noticeably tighter crumb and denser profile compared to other breads, but as ours uses 18% wheat flour, it is a little lighter in flavour and texture. Recipes using Rye Bread Rye bread is famously served in a Scandinavian style, with pickled fish, onions and lots of dill. For something completely different, we love slicing thick wedges of ALMA by Natoora's rye loaf to bake into a rich vanilla-infused custard for an indulgent bread and butter butter. Bake demerara sugar on top for a deeply caramelised crunch. Serve with Natoora stone fruits, like sweet Amarillo peaches. What is Alma? Alma is the Bermondsey-based mill and bakery on a mission to restore the value of whole grain wheat. Our small team of bakers stone-mill diverse grain varieties in-house, making fresh flour that's full of flavour, character and depth. Every ingredient in our loaves is chosen with the same care, for its quality, craftsmanship and flavour. What is Natoora? Natoora was founded in 2004 in a bid to bring flavour, seasonality and transparency back to the way we source and eat food. Today, we work closely with responsible growers to find fruit and veg varieties chosen for flavour, many of which never make it into the mainstream food system. From seed selection to traditional growing methods, we champion the people and practices behind good produce, connecting growers with chefs and home cooks all around the world.

product.further_description: Roasted Garlic Hummus Vegetarian Vegan Dairy-free A head of garlic might seem a lot for a bowl of hummus, but trust us, roasting the garlic makes it sweeter and not so potent. Prep Time: 10 minutes Cooking time: 25 minutes Serves 6 people INGREDIENTS: 1 tin Epicure Chickpeas in Salted Water, save a few for toppin 1 head Roasted garlic (recipe below) 1 tbsp Tahini 1 tbsp Lemon juice 2 tbsp Olive oil ½ tsp Coarse salt 1 tbsp Water, if needed Toppings: Olive oil Smoked paprika Chopped Parsley METHOD: Simply add all the ingredients, except for the water, to the food processor. Drizzle the oil over and let it soak in for one minute. Now, remove the cloves from the base, keeping them in their skins. Toss with the oil, wrap them up in the foil and bake in the middle of the oven for 20-25 min, or until soft. Let cool before using. product.further_description: Jamaican Ginger Cake Moist, rich, and infused with fiery ginger and sweet syrup, this Jamaican ginger cake is pure comfort. Perfect with a cup of tea or enjoyed on its own. Prep time: 30 minutes Cook time: 1 hour Serves 20 people INGREDIENTS: 380g Self-raising flour 1 tbsp Ground ginger 2 tsp Ground allspice 200g Unsalted butter, softened and chopped 250g Dark Muscovado Sugar 3 Eggs, lightly beaten 2 stems Epicure Stem Ginger In Syrup, chopped 250ml Sour cream 60ml Milk 200ml Epicure Date Molasses FOR THE GINGER ICING 180g Icing sugar 1½ tsp Ground ginger Ginger biscuits, crushed METHOD: Preheat oven to 160°C. Grease two loaf tins and line with baking paper. Standard 2lb loaf tin (also referred to as a 900g loaf tin) typically measures around 23cm x 13cm x 7cm (9" x 5" x 3") Place 200g butter and 250g sugar in the bowl and using an electric whisk beat until thick and pale. Add the 3 eggs and beat to combine. Next add the chopped ginger, 250ml sour cream, 60ml milk and 200ml molasses and stir to combine, before folding in the 380g flour and spices (1 tbsp ground ginger and 2 tsp ground all spice. Divide the cake batter into the two prepared loaf tins and bake for 50-55 minutes until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean. Set aside to cool completely in the pan. If you only have one tin, bake in two batches. Cover your cake mix in the bowl with cling film whilst baking. For the ginger icing, sift the icing sugar and ginger into a bowl and gradually add a tsp of water at a time, stirring until well combined and smooth pourable consistency. Turn out your cake and allow it to cool on a wire rack. Drizzle the icing on top generously, sprinkle over crushed ginger biscuits and slice to serve. TIP: This recipe makes two loaves. You can easily freeze this cake for up to three months without icing. Feed lots of hungry mouths or keep one for a later date. product.detailed_description: A celebration of Puglia, the Mediterranean and Italian craftsmanship, Muraglia's Sardines Pop Art bottle turns exceptional extra virgin olive oil into a piece of art for the table. Handmade by artisans in Puglia, the striking white ceramic bottle is decorated with colourful sardines inspired by the Mediterranean. Designed to be seen rather than hidden away in a cupboard, it makes a beautiful statement piece for the kitchen or dining table, an impressive gift, and a ceramic bottle to keep long after the oil is finished. And the beauty is not only on the outside. Inside is Muraglia's Intense Fruity Extra Virgin Olive Oil, made from 100% Coratina olives grown around Andria in Puglia. The olives are processed within 24 hours of harvesting and cold extracted at temperatures not exceeding 27°C. product.brand_marketing: Tasty without compromise. You told us you wanted great taste, good stuff for your body and the planet looked after. Here it is. Delicious, sustainable, organic Alara. We think it is how food should be. Come and join us. Alex Smith started Alara in 1975 with just £2. He is the pioneer of natural and organic food in the UK and has been actively involved in many organisations and projects promoting sustainability. In 1975 Alex created the first recipe for muesli without added sugar. In 1988 Alara was the first cereal company in the world to be certified Organic. In 2008 we became the first food company in the UK with Zero Waste, nothing goes to landfill from our factory. We've never compromised our values and these and many other 'firsts' are part of our commitment to creating delicious sustainable pure foods, and to inspire. If you are inspired, please share our story with your friends and family. Together we can make a difference. Have You Tried? Alara Organic 30 Plants Overnight Alara Organic Classic Apple Bircher
product.detailed_description: 30 Plants Muesli A Diverse Plant-Based Diet Boosts Gut Health Research shows that eating at least 30 different plant-based foods each week supports a more diverse and resilient gut microbiome - linked to numerous health benefits and overall well-being. But it's not just your gut that benefits. Each plant offers its own unique mix of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. By adding variety to your plate, you feed your body the full spectrum of nutrition it needs. (Just don't forget to stay hydrated, move your body, and get a good night's sleep!) Tracking your plant intake can be a challenge-until now. Our 30 Plants products bring together grains, fruits, seeds, nuts, and spices (all 30 of them!) into a vibrant and delicious eating experience that's anything but boring.
product.features: Delicious and sustainable, Net Zero Carbon, Supports Gut Microbiome, Broad Range of Nutrients, High Fibre, Wholegrains, Organic, Suitable for Vegans
product.further_description: Net zero carbon Embedded carbon 131g per 100g We fully offset CO2 by donating to Rainforest Saver They transition farmers in rainforests from traditional "slash and burn" farming, which is damaging forest and releases CO2 to permanent farming using nitrogen fixing Inga alley cropping, which sequesters CO2. We are also working on a project investigating how carbon can be sequestered on a farm in Somerset. Visit www.rainforestsaver.org TÜV Austria - Home S2212 This Isn't Just an Organic Muesli. It's a Movement. When you join the movement of people choosing sustainable products to replace unsustainable alternatives, you are helping to mend the Earth. Alara has gone plastic free! This is another first in our journey towards sustainability. The inner film bag in all our products is made of cellulose and is home compostable, just dispose it in your compost heap, in landfill, it will biodegrade. The box is made of sustainably sourced cardboard and is fully recyclable. We Believe in Organic Arable Farmers and Fairness in the Supply Chain. We source all our oat and barley flakes from British growers. By offering a long term contract and fair prices to the farmers, Alara was instrumental in establishing the Organic Arable Group, which connects small organic farms and has helped the development of the British organic oat sector. Why Organic? There are lots of reasons to choose organic food. www.alara.co.uk/whyorganic

product.brand_marketing: Inspired by Mexico In pursuit of the perfect tortilla, I set out on what would become quite a serendipitous journey across Mexico. Visiting the milpas, molinos and tortillerias, I picked up a new nickname - Blanco Niño - and learnt the secret to making truly authentic tortillas. It's this thousand-year-old recipe that inspired the chips you now hold in your hand. While the Blanco Niño Tortilleria is based in Ireland, we owe our existence to the extraordinary people and history of Mexico. Our team is passionate about Mexican food and dedicated to doing the ancient Aztec recipe justice every day. Traditionally Mexican. Unexpectedly Irish. Phil Philip Martin, Founder Made the Aztec Way We select the very best whole non-GMO corn, which we cook then steep overnight, before grinding into a dough called masa using our hand-carved, Mexican volcanic stones. An ancient process called Nixtamalisation. While still hot, this masa is shaped and baked into tortillas. We then leave the tortillas to rest overnight, before cutting and lightly frying them to become the most delicious, authentic tortilla chips. It takes three days from start to finish, but we think it's worth the wait.
product.detailed_description: Meaty Asado In the heart of the Sonoran Desert of Northern Mexico, food and fire have always been inseparable. As the sun sets over the desert plains, families and friends gather around the traditional asado - an open-fire barbecue. The result is an evening of fireside stories with sprinkled servings of deep smoky meats dished out with salsas, crunchy vegetables and lashings of lime. Here, the asado is more than a cooking method, it is the excuse for friends, family and community to come together. It's this spirit, and those smoky, citrus-kissed flavours, that inspired our Meaty Asado tortilla chips.

product.recipes: Vietnamese lemongrass stir fry Feeds two in 20 minutes You'll need: (stir fry) - 1 pot Vietnamese Lemongrass Stir Fry Paste - 300g chicken breast (thinly sliced) or tofu (cubed) - 1 1/2 tbsp vegetable oil (20g) - 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce (25g) - Whole gem lettuce leaves, sliced cucumber and carrots Nước chấm sauce: Mix & adjust to taste - 50g fresh lime juice - 50g water - 50g sugar - 25g light soy or fish sauce - 20g chopped garlic - 3g chopped red bird's eye chilli Steps 1. As the experts in taste and texture, we’ve always made sure we stay one step ahead—crafting products that elevate everyday meals and make those shared food moments even better. Our diverse range of Stuffings and Breadcrumbs are designed to help you add depth, crunch, and deliciousness to any dish. From a quick mid‑week meals that needs a simple flavour and texture boost, to the beloved Sunday roast dinner where Paxo has a starring role, and even festive feasts that bring the whole family together— remember a Roast isn’t a Roast without Paxo. Whenever you’re cooking, and whoever you’re cooking for, Paxo has something perfect for every occasion.
product.detailed_description: Elevating your meals with added texture and crunch just got easier! With a subtle seasoning for extra flavour, Paxo Golden Breadcrumbs are an easy way to add a crispy coating to meat or vegetables, or create a crunchy topping on pasta bakes. The resealable drum makes these a store cupboard staple that'll be on hand whenever you're making midweek dinners or preparing a feast for friends. Simply dip your meat, fish, or veggies in flour, beaten egg and then coat in Paxo Golden Breadcrumbs before baking, grilling, or frying. They are also great for thickening soups or mixing into your burger patties for extra texture and flavour.

product.recipes: Chicken Tikka Naans Prep time: 10 mins Cook time: 5 mins Serves: 4 Perfect for a light lunch or snack, these mini chicken tikka naans are ideal. Ready in just 15 mins, they are so versatile and a guaranteed crowd pleaser. We’ve topped ours with chicken but try these with tikka-marinated roasted cauliflower or paneer for a veggie version. Ingredients: ¼ cucumber, deseeded and finely chopped 2 tomatoes, deseeded and finely chopped 1 small red onion, finely chopped 4 mini naan breads 6 tbsp plain yoghurt 1 garlic clove, grated 1 tbsp dried mint 2 (150g) packet chicken tikka breast pieces, shredded 3 sprigs coriander, leaves picked Method: Step 1 Toss the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion together in a bowl until well mixed to make a kachumber then set aside. Step 2 Heat the grill to medium. Cook the naan bread to packet instructions. Step 3 Meanwhile, mix the yoghurt, garlic and dried mint in a small bowl then season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Step 4 Remove the naan bread from the oven and evenly spread the yoghurt mixture over each. Top with shredded chicken and transfer to a serving plate. Step 5 Top each with 2 tbsp of the kachumber mix then transfer the rest to a small serving dish. Sprinkle the naans with coriander and serve with the bowl of remaining kachumber.

The Distillery, founded in 1866 by Mr. Jack Daniel in Lynchburg, Tennessee, is one of the most well-known producers of whiskey in the world. Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey is made with the finest corn, rye and barley malt. Its distinctive character is a result of natural fermentation, careful distillation, and use of the Distillery's iron-free water from the Cave Spring that runs at a constant 56° F.
product.detailed_description: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 is a premium Tennessee Whiskey. A warm amber colour with aromas of sweet vanilla, this is a smooth, full-bodied whiskey, with flavours of orange, brown sugar and spice, and a long rich finish. Jack Daniel registered his distillery in 1866, making it the oldest registered distillery in the United States. It's here in Lynchburg that every drop of Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey is still distilled and matured today. During its 150 year history, Jack Daniel's has won numerous gold medals around the world. Its success can be put down to the unique way in which the famous 'Old No.7' brand is made, the same way it always has - using the finest corn, rye and barley malt; pure, iron-free water from the Cave Spring in the Distillery hollow; being mellowed through 10 feet of sugar maple charcoal; and aged in hand-crafted charred oak barrels. It is this unique way of making whiskey and the extra steps such as charcoal mellowing that makes Jack Daniel's what it is - a smooth sipping Tennessee whiskey and not a bourbon.
